attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the patient prefers to be called, which may differ from their legal name. Used in patient-facing communications, care team interactions, and patient experience initiatives. Supports LGBTQ+ inclusive care.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.name (use=nickname); Joint Commission Patient-Centered Care Standards

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Patient's primary contact telephone number. Used for appointment reminders, care coordination, and emergency contact. Sourced from Epic ADT registration.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.telecom (use=home|mobile); TCPA

attributes.name: primary_phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the patient's primary phone number (home landline, mobile/cell, work). Determines eligibility for automated outreach under TCPA regulations.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.telecom.system; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: pronouns
attributes.description: Patient's preferred personal pronouns for use in clinical communications and care team interactions. Supports inclusive, patient-centered care and Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (individual-pronouns); Joint Commission LGBTQ+ Inclusive Care Standards

attributes.name: race_code
attributes.description: Patient's self-reported race using OMB/CDC race category codes. Required for CMS demographic reporting, HEDIS measures, population health stratification, and health equity analytics. Supports multiple race selections per OMB standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1002-5|2028-9|2054-5|2076-8|2106-3|2131-1|UNK — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OMB Race and Ethnicity Standards (1997); CMS Interoperability Rule; USCDI v3; NCQA HEDIS; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (us-core-race)

attributes.name: race_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the patient's self-reported race category (e.g., 'American Indian or Alaska Native', 'Asian', 'Black or African American'). Paired with race_code for display and reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Race and Ethnicity Standards (1997); USCDI v3; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (us-core-race)

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the patient's demographic record in the MPI. Active=current patient, Inactive=no recent encounters, Merged=duplicate resolved into another record, Deceased=patient has died, Test=test/training record.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.active; IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; Epic ADT

attributes.name: religion_code
attributes.description: Patient's self-reported religious affiliation using HL7 v3 ReligiousAffiliation code set. Informs chaplaincy services, dietary restrictions, end-of-life care preferences, and culturally competent care delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product per HL7 v3 ReligiousAffiliation value set]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (patient-religion); HL7 v3 ReligiousAffiliation; Joint Commission Spiritual Care Standards

attributes.name: sdoh_food_insecurity
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Food Insecurity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has screened positive for food insecurity. Core SDOH data element supporting care management referrals, population health stratification, and CMS health equity reporting.
attributes.references: USCDI v3 SDOH; CMS Health Equity Reporting; AHRQ SDOH Framework; ICD-10-CM Z59.4; HL7 FHIR Gravity Project

tag_set.value: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Food Insecurity Flag

attributes.name: sdoh_housing_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Housing Status
attributes.description: Patient's self-reported housing stability status. Core SDOH data element used for population health stratification, care management prioritization, and CMS health equity reporting.
attributes.references: USCDI v3 SDOH; CMS Health Equity Reporting; AHRQ SDOH Framework; ICD-10-CM Z59 Codes; HL7 FHIR Gravity Project

tag_set.value: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Housing Status

attributes.name: sex_at_birth
attributes.description: Biological sex assigned at birth as recorded on the birth certificate. Distinct from gender identity. Required for clinical decision support, lab reference ranges, and CMS demographic reporting. Values: M=Male, F=Female, X=Intersex/Other, U=Unknown.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (us-core-birthsex); CMS Interoperability Rule; USCDI v3; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: ssn_last4
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Security Number Last 4 Digits (SSN Last 4)
attributes.description: Last four digits of the patient's Social Security Number. Used for identity verification and insurance eligibility checks without storing the full SSN. Full SSN is not stored per HIPAA minimum necessary and PCI DSS principles.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; NIST SP 800-122; IRS Publication 1075

tag_set.value: Social Security Number Last 4 Digits (SSN Last 4)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the patient demographics record. Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; HL7 FHIR R4 Meta.lastUpdated

attributes.name: vip_indicator
attributes.description: Flags the patient as a VIP (e.g., celebrity, executive, employee, or high-profile individual) requiring enhanced privacy protections and special handling protocols. Triggers restricted access controls and audit logging per HIPAA minimum necessary standard.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Joint Commission Patient Privacy Standards; OIG Compliance Guidance

products.name: address
products.description: Patient address records supporting multiple address types (home, mailing, temporary, work) with full address components, geocoding coordinates, county/census tract for SDOH analysis, address validation status, effective date ranges, and do-not-mail flags. Supports population health outreach, care gap closure, and SDOH stratification. Sourced from Epic and Cerner registration systems.
products.reference: USPS Address Standardization — HL7 FHIR Address DataType

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each patient address record in the Master Patient Index (MPI). Primary key for the patient.address data product.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient record in the Master Patient Index (MPI) to whom this address belongs. Links address to the patient master.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active indicates the address is in use; inactive indicates it has been superseded; undeliverable indicates mail has been returned or the address is not reachable; returned_mail indicates USPS or courier returned correspondence.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose of the address record. Supported types: home (primary residence), mailing (preferred correspondence), temporary (short-term stay), work (employer location), billing (financial correspondence), guarantor (responsible party address). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: home|mailing|temporary|work|billing|guarantor — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.use

attributes.name: area_deprivation_index
attributes.description: National Area Deprivation Index (ADI) score derived from the census tract of this address, ranging from 1 (least deprived) to 100 (most deprived). Used for SDOH risk stratification, population health segmentation, and value-based care program targeting.
attributes.references: University of Wisconsin Neighborhood Atlas ADI; AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS SDOH Reporting

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: U.S. Census Bureau census tract identifier for the address location. Used for SDOH stratification, Area Deprivation Index (ADI) linkage, and population health analytics to identify socioeconomic risk factors.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau; AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS SDOH Reporting; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the patient address. Used for population health outreach, care gap closure, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) stratification.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Publication 28; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.city

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international patient populations and cross-border care coordination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.country

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name associated with the patient address. Used for SDOH stratification, public health reporting, and county-level population health analytics.
attributes.references: AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS Geographic Reporting; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code uniquely identifying the county. Enables linkage to census data, Area Deprivation Index (ADI), and federal SDOH datasets for population health management.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS; AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS Geographic Reporting

tag_set.value: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the source system or the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA access logging requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; ISO 27001; Epic EHR Audit Trail

attributes.name: district
attributes.description: Administrative district or borough associated with the address. Used in urban markets and international patient populations for sub-county geographic segmentation and population health reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Address.district; U.S. Census Bureau

attributes.name: do_not_contact_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason why the patient has requested no contact at this address (e.g., patient request, domestic violence protection, deceased, address undeliverable). Supports HIPAA confidential communications compliance and patient preference management.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; Epic Patient Preferences; Cerner Millennium

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this address record is no longer active for the patient. Null indicates the address is currently active. Supports historical address tracking and transitions of care documentation.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.period.end

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is considered active and valid for the patient. Supports temporal address management, enabling historical address lookups and point-in-time reporting for care coordination and billing.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.period.start

attributes.name: geocode_precision
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded coordinates indicating how accurately the latitude/longitude represents the address. Rooftop is highest precision; ungeocoded indicates geocoding has not been performed or failed.
attributes.references: AHRQ SDOH Framework; Google Maps Geocoding API Standards; USPS Address Validation

attributes.name: health_service_area
attributes.description: Dartmouth Atlas Health Service Area (HSA) or facility-defined service area code associated with the address. Used for population health management, market analysis, and care utilization reporting.
attributes.references: Dartmouth Atlas of Health Care; CMS Geographic Reporting; AHRQ

attributes.name: housing_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the patient's housing situation at this address. Supports Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) screening, housing instability risk stratification, and population health management programs. Aligned with AHRQ SDOH domain of housing instability.
attributes.references: AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS SDOH Reporting; NCQA HEDIS; ICD-10-CM Z59 Codes

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates the address is marked confidential and must not be disclosed to unauthorized parties, including family members. Supports domestic violence protections, sensitive patient situations, and HIPAA confidential communications requirements under 45 CFR §164.522(b).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522(b); Epic Confidential Address; Cerner Sensitive Patient Flag

attributes.name: is_do_not_mail
attributes.description: Indicates the patient has requested that no physical mail be sent to this address. Enforced during population health outreach, care gap closure mailings, and marketing communications to honor patient preferences and comply with HIPAA minimum necessary standards.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; CMS Patient Rights; Epic MyChart Preferences

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the patient's primary address of record. Only one address per patient should be flagged as primary at any given time. Used by clinical and billing systems to select the default address for correspondence.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.use

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) derived from geocoding the address. Supports spatial analytics, drive-time analysis, care access mapping, and population health outreach routing.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System; AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS Geographic Access Standards

attributes.name: line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number and street name. First line of the patient's physical or mailing address as captured in Epic or Cerner registration.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Publication 28; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.line

attributes.name: line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, floor, or building designator. Supplements address_line1 for multi-unit dwellings.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Publication 28; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.line

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) derived from geocoding the address. Supports spatial analytics, drive-time analysis, care access mapping, and population health outreach routing.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System; AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS Geographic Access Standards

attributes.name: move_in_date
attributes.description: Date the patient moved into or began residing at this address, as reported by the patient during registration or updated via patient portal. Supports address tenure analysis and SDOH housing stability assessments.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; AHRQ SDOH Framework

attributes.name: move_out_date
attributes.description: Date the patient moved out of or ceased residing at this address, as reported during registration update or returned mail processing. Used to close address records and trigger re-registration workflows.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; USPS NCOA

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number assigned to the patient by the facility. Carried on the address record to support address-level patient identification and deduplication workflows in the Master Patient Index (MPI).
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: ncoa_match_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Match Code
attributes.description: USPS NCOA match result code indicating the outcome of the change-of-address lookup (e.g., individual match, family match, business match, no match, moved with no forwarding address). Used to assess address currency and trigger update workflows.
attributes.references: USPS NCOA; USPS Publication 28

tag_set.value: National Change of Address (NCOA) Match Code

attributes.name: ncoa_update_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Update Date
attributes.description: Date on which this address was last updated via USPS National Change of Address (NCOA) processing. Supports address hygiene programs and ensures outreach mailings reach patients who have relocated.
attributes.references: USPS NCOA; USPS Publication 28; NCQA HEDIS Outreach Standards

tag_set.value: National Change of Address (NCOA) Update Date

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: USPS ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the address. Used for geographic routing, population health outreach, and SDOH analysis. Note: Per HIPAA Safe Harbor, full 9-digit ZIP codes for small geographic areas may require de-identification.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(b)(2)(i); CMS Geographic Adjustment

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code representing the patient's preferred language for written communications sent to this address (e.g., en, es, zh). Supports culturally competent outreach and CMS language access requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; CMS Language Access Requirements; Section 1557 ACA; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: sdoh_housing_instability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Housing Instability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates the patient has been identified as experiencing housing instability at this address based on SDOH screening (e.g., PRAPARE, AHC HRSN). Triggers care management interventions and community resource referrals.
attributes.references: AHRQ SDOH Framework; CMS SDOH Reporting; ICD-10-CM Z59; NCQA HEDIS

tag_set.value: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Housing Instability Flag

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this address record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic address record ID, Cerner address sequence number). Supports ETL reconciliation, deduplication, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state or territory abbreviation (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Used for state-level regulatory reporting, licensure verification, and population health segmentation.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CMS State Reporting

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or automated process that last modified this address record. Supports HIPAA audit trail requirements and data stewardship accountability.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; ISO 27001; The Joint Commission Record Integrity Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified in the source system or the Silver Layer data product. Supports change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; ISO 27001; Epic EHR Audit Trail

attributes.name: urban_rural_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the address location as urban, suburban, rural, or frontier based on USDA Rural-Urban Commuting Area (RUCA) codes or HRSA definitions. Used for CMS geographic payment adjustments, rural health program eligibility, and access-to-care analytics.
attributes.references: USDA RUCA Codes; HRSA Rural Health Policy; CMS Geographic Adjustment; AHRQ

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last validated against USPS or a third-party address verification service. Supports re-validation scheduling and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the system or service used to validate the address (e.g., USPS CASS, Melissa Data, SmartyStreets, Epic Address Validation). Supports audit trails for address quality management.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current USPS or third-party address validation status. Validated indicates the address was confirmed deliverable by USPS CASS certification or equivalent. Corrected indicates the address was standardized during validation. Used to ensure accuracy of outreach mailings and care gap closure communications.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; USPS Publication 28; NCQA HEDIS Outreach Standards

products.name: insurance_coverage
products.description: Patient insurance coverage, eligibility, and verification records. Captures payer name, plan name, plan type (HMO, PPO, POS, Medicare, Medicaid, self-pay), member ID, group number, subscriber relationship, coverage effective and termination dates, coordination of benefits (COB) priority, copay/deductible/out-of-pocket amounts, pre-authorization requirements, and real-time/batch eligibility verification transactions (270/271 EDI, portal, phone) with verification status, confirmed coverage details, verification date/time, payer queried, and verification audit trail. SSOT for patient payer eligibility and verification consumed by billing and claims domains. Supports front-end RCM workflows, claim denial prevention, and prior authorization management. Aligned with X12 270/271 transaction standards and HL7 FHIR Coverage resource. Sourced from EHR revenue cycle and eligibility verification modules.
products.reference: HIPAA 270/271 Eligibility Transaction — HL7 FHIR Coverage Resource

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each insurance coverage record in the patient domain. Primary key for the insurance_coverage data product.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage Resource R4

attributes.name: primary_insurance_member_mpi_record_id
attributes.description: The insurance member identification number assigned by the payer to uniquely identify the insured individual. Used in eligibility verification (X12 270/271), claims submission (CMS-1500, UB-04), and Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) matching.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; CMS-1500; UB-04; HL7 FHIR Coverage.identifier

attributes.name: benefit_year_end
attributes.description: The end date of the insurance plan's benefit year (plan year). Used to reset deductible and out-of-pocket accumulator tracking and to identify coverage renewal requirements.
attributes.references: ACA §1302; HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Plan Year Definitions

attributes.name: benefit_year_start
attributes.description: The start date of the insurance plan's benefit year (plan year). Used to reset deductible and out-of-pocket accumulator tracking. May differ from the coverage effective date for mid-year enrollments.
attributes.references: ACA §1302; HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Plan Year Definitions

attributes.name: cob_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority order for Coordination of Benefits (COB) when a patient has multiple insurance coverages. 1 = primary payer, 2 = secondary payer, 3 = tertiary payer. Governs claim submission sequencing and payment responsibility allocation.
attributes.references: X12 837 COB segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.order; CMS COB Guidelines; NAIC Model COB Regulation

attributes.name: coinsurance_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of covered service costs the patient is responsible for after the deductible is met, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 = 20%). Used in patient financial counseling and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) estimation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; X12 271 BEN segment; ACA §1302

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount the patient is required to pay at the time of service for a covered visit or procedure (e.g., $25 primary care, $50 specialist). Used in point-of-service collection and patient financial counseling.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; X12 271 BEN segment; CMS Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insurance coverage record. Drives eligibility verification workflows, claim submission eligibility, and front-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) processes. Active = currently valid; Pending = awaiting confirmation; Terminated = coverage ended; Suspended = temporarily inactive.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage.status; X12 271 AAA segment; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this insurance coverage record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA audit control requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; Joint Commission IM Standards; ISO 27001

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount the patient must pay out-of-pocket before the insurance plan begins covering costs. Expressed in USD. Used in patient financial counseling, prior authorization, and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; X12 271 BEN segment; CMS Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: deductible_met_amount
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount the patient has applied toward their annual deductible. Sourced from real-time eligibility verification (X12 271) responses. Used in patient financial counseling and point-of-service collection.
attributes.references: X12 271 BEN segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; CMS Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurance coverage becomes effective and claims may be submitted. Used in eligibility verification and coordination of benefits (COB) sequencing. Aligns with X12 271 DTP*356 segment.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 DTP*356; HL7 FHIR Coverage.period.start; CMS-1500 Box 11c

attributes.name: eligibility_response_code
attributes.description: The X12 271 AAA or EB segment response code returned by the payer during eligibility verification, indicating the specific eligibility status or rejection reason (e.g., '1' = Active Coverage, 'AAA' = Rejection). Supports denial prevention and RCM analytics.
attributes.references: X12 271 EB/AAA segments; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityResponse.error; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1301

attributes.name: eligibility_transaction_number
attributes.description: The unique transaction control number (TCN) or trace number assigned to the X12 270/271 eligibility verification transaction or FHIR CoverageEligibilityRequest. Enables end-to-end audit trail and transaction reconciliation.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 BHT*0022 segment; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityRequest.identifier; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the most recent eligibility verification for this coverage. Supports audit trail requirements and verification workflow analytics. EDI_270_271 = X12 batch or real-time transaction; portal = payer web portal; phone = verbal verification; real_time_API = FHIR-based real-time check.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityRequest R4; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1301

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_status
attributes.description: The current status of the most recent eligibility verification transaction for this coverage record. Reflects the outcome of X12 270/271 EDI, portal, or phone-based verification. Drives front-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows and claim denial prevention.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityResponse; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_by
attributes.description: The name or system identifier of the staff member, automated process, or clearinghouse that performed the most recent eligibility verification. Supports audit trail and accountability for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 (Audit Controls); CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the most recent eligibility verification was completed. Used in the eligibility verification audit trail and to determine whether re-verification is required based on payer-specific or organizational SLA policies.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityResponse; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group plan number assigned by the payer that identifies the specific group policy under which the member is covered. Required for claims submission and eligibility verification.

attributes.name: insurance_card_back_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or document reference to the scanned or photographed back of the patient's insurance card. Stored in a HIPAA-compliant document management system. Contains payer contact information and claims submission instructions.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.502; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: insurance_card_front_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or document reference to the scanned or photographed front of the patient's insurance card. Stored in a HIPAA-compliant document management system. Used for manual verification and patient registration workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.502; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: medicaid_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state Medicaid program under which the patient is enrolled. Null for non-Medicaid plans. Required for Medicaid claim submission and state-specific billing rules.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid State Plan; 42 CFR §430; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: medicare_part
attributes.description: For Medicare coverage, identifies the specific Medicare part: A (Hospital Insurance), B (Medical Insurance), C (Medicare Advantage/HMO), or D (Prescription Drug Coverage). Null for non-Medicare plans. Drives CMS billing rules and claim form selection.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Benefit Policy Manual; 42 CFR §410; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's coverage is being used within the payer's contracted provider network (in-network) or outside it (out-of-network). Affects patient cost-sharing, claim adjudication rates, and denial risk.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Network Adequacy Standards 42 CFR §438.68; NCQA

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max
attributes.description: The maximum annual amount the patient is required to pay out-of-pocket for covered services, after which the plan covers 100% of costs. Used in patient financial counseling and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows.
attributes.references: ACA §1302(c); HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; X12 271 BEN segment

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_met_amount
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount the patient has applied toward their annual out-of-pocket maximum. Sourced from real-time eligibility verification (X12 271) responses. Informs point-of-service collection decisions.
attributes.references: X12 271 BEN segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; ACA §1302(c)

attributes.name: payer_electronic_number
attributes.description: The electronic payer identification number used for submitting X12 EDI transactions (270/271 eligibility, 837 claims). Also known as the EDI payer ID or clearinghouse payer ID. Distinct from the NPI.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 NM1*PR NM109; CMS EDI Companion Guide; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: The commercial name of the insurance plan as designated by the payer (e.g., 'Blue Shield PPO Gold', 'Aetna HMO Select'). Used for patient-facing communications and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage.class (plan); NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance plan type indicating the network and coverage structure. Drives prior authorization requirements, referral rules, and claim adjudication logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HMO|PPO|POS|EPO|Medicare|Medicaid|self_pay|TRICARE|CHIP|workers_comp|commercial — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Taxonomy; HL7 FHIR Coverage.type; NCQA

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance plan requires prior authorization (pre-authorization) before certain services, procedures, or medications are covered. Drives pre-authorization workflows in Order Management and Surgical/Procedural Scheduling.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Prior Authorization Rule (CMS-0057-F); AMA CPT Prior Auth Guidelines

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance plan requires a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) before the patient can see a specialist. Applicable primarily to Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) and Point of Service (POS) plans.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR §438; NCQA HMO Standards

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.description: The 6-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN) used to route pharmacy claims to the correct Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM). Printed on the insurance card and required for real-time pharmacy eligibility and adjudication via NCPDP SCRIPT standard.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; ANSI X12 278; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: The pharmacy benefit group number used to identify the specific pharmacy benefit plan within the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) system. Printed on the insurance card alongside RxBIN and PCN.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: The Processor Control Number (PCN) used in conjunction with the RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct sub-processor within the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM). Required for pharmacy eligibility verification.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier for this coverage record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic coverage record ID, Cerner insurance record ID). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: subscriber_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the patient (beneficiary) to the primary insurance subscriber. Determines coordination of benefits (COB) rules and claim filing requirements. 'Self' indicates the patient is the primary subscriber.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 INS segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.relationship; CMS-1500 Box 6

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurance coverage ends or is terminated. Null indicates open-ended active coverage. Used to prevent claim submission for services rendered outside the coverage period. Aligns with X12 271 DTP*357 segment.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 DTP*357; HL7 FHIR Coverage.period.end; CMS-1500 Box 11c

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this insurance coverage record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; Joint Commission IM Standards; ISO 27001

products.name: guarantor
products.description: Financial guarantor record identifying the individual or entity responsible for patient account balances. Captures guarantor name, relationship to patient, address, phone, employer information, SSN (masked), and account responsibility percentage. Supports RCM billing workflows, patient financial counseling, and self-pay collection processes. Sourced from EHR revenue cycle and patient accounting modules.
products.reference: UB-04 / CMS-1500 Guarantor Fields — Epic Guarantor Record

attributes.name: guarantor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the financial guarantor record within the patient accounting system. Primary key for the guarantor entity; referenced by patient account and billing records across the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB / Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Master

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient record for whom this guarantor is financially responsible. Links the guarantor to the Master Patient Index (MPI) and enables RCM workflows to associate account balances with the correct patient.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB / Cerner Revenue Cycle — Patient-Guarantor Link; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Guarantor accounts are created and managed at a specific facility (org_provider). Billing, collections, financial assistance programs, and statement generation all require knowing which org_provider o
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: patient_demographics_id
attributes.description: add column patient_demographics_id (BIGINT) with FK to patient.demographics.demographics_id - guarantor links to mpi_record but not demographics; guarantor contact information resolution requires demographics linkage

attributes.name: account_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance owed by the guarantor on the patient account in USD. Represents the net self-pay balance after insurance adjudication, contractual adjustments, and payments applied. Core metric for RCM self-pay collection and patient financial counseling.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Balance; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known patient accounting number assigned to the guarantor account in the EHR revenue cycle or patient accounting system (e.g., Epic Resolute HB guarantor account number). Used by billing staff, financial counselors, and self-pay collection teams to identify and reference the account.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Account; MEDITECH Expanse Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guarantor account within the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflow. Drives billing, collection, and write-off processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|collections|bad_debt|deceased|bankruptcy — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Account Status; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the guarantor's mailing or billing address. Used for billing statement delivery, collection correspondence, and address verification in RCM workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the guarantor (apartment, suite, unit, floor, PO Box). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address used in billing and collection correspondence.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: annual_income
attributes.description: Self-reported or verified annual gross income of the guarantor in USD. Used for financial assistance (charity care) eligibility screening, sliding-scale fee determination, and payment plan structuring per CMS and ACA financial assistance requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: bad_debt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor account balance has been written off as bad debt in the patient accounting system. Supports financial reporting, bad debt reserve calculations, and RAC audit documentation per GAAP and CMS guidelines.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 954; CMS Bad Debt Reimbursement Guidelines; Epic Resolute HB — Bad Debt

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has filed for bankruptcy protection. When True, all collection activities must cease immediately per the automatic stay provisions of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code (11 U.S.C. §362) and the account is flagged for legal review.
attributes.references: U.S. Bankruptcy Code 11 U.S.C. §362; FDCPA; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Status

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the guarantor's billing or mailing address. Used in billing statement generation, collection correspondence, and geographic analytics for patient financial services.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: collection_agency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor account has been referred to an external collection agency for bad debt recovery. When True, direct billing and collection activities by the healthcare organization are suspended per FDCPA requirements.
attributes.references: FDCPA 15 U.S.C. §1692; Epic Resolute HB — Collections; OIG Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international patient billing and cross-border financial correspondence.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantor record was first created in the patient accounting system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage, and HIPAA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the guarantor individual in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for identity verification, eligibility determination for financial assistance programs, and demographic analytics in patient financial services.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: deceased_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor is deceased. When True, billing and collection workflows are routed to estate billing processes and direct collection outreach is suspended per FDCPA and state probate law requirements.
attributes.references: FDCPA 15 U.S.C. §1692; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Status; State Probate Laws

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has requested cessation of all billing and collection contact. When True, all outreach activities are suppressed in compliance with FDCPA cease-and-desist provisions and HIPAA patient rights.
attributes.references: FDCPA 15 U.S.C. §1692c; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; TCPA

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the guarantor used for electronic billing statements (e-statements), payment portal communications, and financial counseling correspondence. Consent for electronic communication must be documented per HIPAA and CAN-SPAM Act.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CAN-SPAM Act; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the guarantor's current employer. Used in financial counseling, self-pay collection assessments, and financial assistance (charity care) eligibility screening to evaluate ability to pay.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Employer

attributes.name: employer_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the guarantor's employer. Used in self-pay collection processes and financial counseling to verify employment status and facilitate payment arrangements.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment status of the guarantor. Used in financial assistance (charity care) eligibility determination, payment plan structuring, and self-pay collection risk stratification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employed_full_time|employed_part_time|self_employed|unemployed|retired|student|disabled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; CMS Financial Assistance Policy Guidelines

attributes.name: estatement_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has consented to receive electronic billing statements (e-statements) via email or patient portal in lieu of paper statements. Supports paperless billing initiatives and reduces statement delivery costs in RCM.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; Epic MyChart — Patient Portal; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: federal_poverty_level_pct
attributes.description: Calculated Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage for the guarantor's household based on annual income and household size. Determines eligibility tier for financial assistance programs, charity care, and sliding-scale discounts per ACA Section 501(r) and CMS guidelines.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); HHS Federal Poverty Guidelines; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: financial_assistance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the guarantor's financial assistance (charity care) application. Drives billing hold, discount application, and collection suspension workflows in the RCM system. Supports ACA Section 501(r) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: financial_assistance_type
attributes.description: Type of financial assistance program approved or applied for by the guarantor. Determines the discount percentage, payment schedule, and billing workflow applied to the account. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charity_care|sliding_scale|payment_plan|hardship|medicaid_pending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; Epic Resolute HB — Financial Assistance

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the guarantor individual. Used in billing correspondence, patient financial counseling communications, and self-pay collection outreach. Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA when linked to patient account data.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor indicating whether the responsible party is the patient themselves, a family member, a legal guardian, an estate, or an organization. Determines billing workflow routing and financial counseling approach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|parent|spouse|legal_guardian|estate|organization — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Type; Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Classification

attributes.name: home_phone
attributes.description: Home telephone number of the guarantor. Primary contact channel for billing inquiries, financial counseling outreach, and self-pay collection calls. Stored in compliance with HIPAA and Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the guarantor's household. Used in conjunction with annual income to determine Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage for financial assistance (charity care) eligibility and sliding-scale fee calculations.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); HHS Federal Poverty Guidelines; CMS Financial Assistance Policy

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family) name of the guarantor individual. Used in billing correspondence, collection letters, and identity verification for patient financial services.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the most recent payment received from the guarantor in USD. Used alongside last_payment_date for payment plan compliance monitoring, collection risk assessment, and RCM reporting.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment History; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from the guarantor toward the outstanding account balance. Used in collection aging analysis, payment plan compliance monitoring, and bad debt risk stratification.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment History; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent billing statement was generated and sent to the guarantor. Used to track billing cycle compliance, manage statement frequency, and support collection escalation timelines in RCM.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Statement Management; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the guarantor individual. Supports identity verification and disambiguation in patient accounting and self-pay collection workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number of the guarantor. Supports SMS billing notifications, payment reminders, and collection outreach. Consent for text messaging must be captured separately per TCPA requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization acting as guarantor when the responsible party is a business entity, estate, or institution rather than an individual. Populated when guarantor_type is 'organization' or 'estate'.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Organization; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: payment_plan_amount
attributes.description: Agreed monthly payment amount under the guarantor's active payment plan arrangement in USD. Used by RCM billing staff to monitor payment plan compliance and trigger collection escalation if payments are missed.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment Plans; Cerner Revenue Cycle; FDCPA

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has an active payment plan arrangement for the outstanding account balance. When True, collection activities are suspended and the account follows the payment plan schedule in the RCM system.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment Plans; Cerner Revenue Cycle; FDCPA

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address. Used for billing statement delivery, collection correspondence, and geographic segmentation in patient financial analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS ZIP Code Standards

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Guarantor's preferred method of contact for billing statements, payment reminders, and financial counseling communications. Drives outreach channel selection in RCM workflows and patient financial services.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Preferences; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522

attributes.name: relationship_to_patient
attributes.description: Describes the guarantor's relationship to the patient as defined in the EHR patient accounting module. Used for financial counseling, billing correspondence, and HIPAA-compliant disclosure of account information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|sibling|grandparent|legal_guardian|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Relationship; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502; HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson

attributes.name: responsibility_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total patient account balance for which this guarantor is financially responsible. Supports scenarios where multiple guarantors share responsibility for a single patient account (e.g., divorced parents of a minor patient). Value range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Responsibility; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: since_date
attributes.description: Date on which the individual or organization was first established as the financial guarantor for the patient account. Marks the effective start of financial responsibility and is used in RCM aging analysis and financial counseling workflows.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Account; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has provided explicit written consent to receive SMS/text message billing notifications and payment reminders. Required for TCPA compliance before sending automated text messages to the guarantor's mobile phone.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; FCC TCPA Regulations; Epic Resolute HB — Communication Preferences

attributes.name: ssn_masked
attributes.description: Masked Social Security Number (SSN) of the guarantor, displaying only the last four digits (format: XXX-XX-NNNN). Used for identity verification in self-pay collections, financial assistance screening, and credit bureau reporting. Full SSN must never be stored in the Silver layer per HIPAA and PCI DSS data minimization requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; IRS Publication 1075

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Used for billing correspondence, state-specific financial assistance program eligibility, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS State Abbreviations; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantor record was most recently modified in the patient accounting system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail requirements, and Silver layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Work telephone number of the guarantor. Used as an alternate contact channel for billing and collection communications when home phone is unavailable. Stored in compliance with HIPAA and TCPA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

products.name: emergency_contact
products.description: Patient emergency contact records capturing contact name, relationship type, priority order, phone numbers (home, mobile, work), address, and authorization level (e.g., authorized to receive PHI, healthcare proxy, legal guardian). Supports EMTALA compliance, care coordination, and discharge planning workflows. Sourced from Epic and Cerner registration modules.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson Resource — EMTALA Contact Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the emergency contact record in the Master Patient Index (MPI) system. Primary key for the emergency_contact data product.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson Resource

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient for whom this emergency contact is registered. Links to the patient master record in the Master Patient Index (MPI).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.patient; Epic Registration Module

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the emergency contact's residence. Used for written correspondence, legal notifications, and discharge planning documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the emergency contact (e.g., apartment number, suite, unit). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of residence for the emergency contact. Used in conjunction with state and postal code for complete address resolution and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the patient provided consent to designate this individual as an emergency contact and/or authorized recipient of PHI. Required for HIPAA audit trails and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); OCR HIPAA Guidance; TJC RI.01.03.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member (e.g., registration clerk, nurse) who obtained the patient's consent to designate this emergency contact. Supports HIPAA audit trail requirements and accountability in the registration workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); OCR HIPAA Guidance; TJC RI.01.03.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the emergency contact record. Active = currently valid and reachable; Inactive = no longer applicable (e.g., relationship ended); Deceased = contact has died; Unverified = contact information has not been confirmed with the patient.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.active; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's role relative to the patient. Determines the scope of authority and notification priority. Values include emergency_contact (general notification), healthcare_proxy (authorized to make medical decisions), legal_guardian (legal authority over patient), authorized_representative (authorized to receive PHI per HIPAA), next_of_kin (biological/legal family), guarantor (financial responsibility). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_contact|healthcare_proxy|legal_guardian|authorized_representative|next_of_kin|guarantor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.relationship; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510; Epic Registration

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the emergency contact's address. Supports international patients and contacts residing outside the United States.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.country

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, HIPAA compliance, and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); HITRUST CSF Control 09.ab; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Epic Registration

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this emergency contact designation is no longer valid (e.g., divorce, death of contact, revocation by patient). Null indicates the contact is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.period.end; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this emergency contact designation is considered valid and active. Supports temporal validity tracking for contact records, particularly when contacts change over time (e.g., new spouse, new guardian).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.period.start; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the emergency contact. Used for non-urgent communications, appointment notifications, and electronic delivery of care summaries or discharge instructions where PHI authorization permits.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HITECH Act; Epic MyChart Registration

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given (first) name of the emergency contact individual. Used for identification and communication during care coordination and emergency notification workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName.given; Epic Registration

attributes.name: healthcare_proxy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has been designated as the patient's healthcare proxy (durable power of attorney for healthcare decisions). When True, this individual is legally authorized to make medical decisions on behalf of the patient if the patient is incapacitated. Distinct from phi_disclosure_authorized.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510; State Health Proxy Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: home_phone
attributes.description: Residential landline phone number for the emergency contact. Used as a secondary contact channel when mobile phone is unavailable. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: interpreter_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a professional interpreter is required when communicating with this emergency contact. Supports compliance with Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) language access requirements and TJC communication standards.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; TJC RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Registration

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family (last) name of the emergency contact individual. Used in conjunction with first_name for full identity resolution and communication.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName.family; Epic Registration

attributes.name: legal_guardian_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds legal guardianship over the patient (e.g., parent of a minor, court-appointed guardian for an incapacitated adult). When True, this individual has legal authority over the patient's care decisions and access to medical records.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Guardianship Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: lives_with_patient
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emergency contact resides in the same household as the patient. Relevant for discharge planning, home care coordination, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) assessments.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Reporting; TJC Discharge Planning Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the emergency contact. Supports full legal name resolution and disambiguation when multiple contacts share the same first and last name.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile (cell) phone number for the emergency contact. Preferred channel for urgent notifications and SMS-based communication during emergency and discharge planning workflows. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); Epic Registration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional clinical or administrative notes about this emergency contact (e.g., 'Contact is deaf — use text messaging only', 'Contact travels frequently — try mobile first'). Supports nuanced care coordination and communication planning.
attributes.references: TJC Patient-Centered Communication Standards; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: notification_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has explicitly consented to this contact being notified in the event of an emergency, admission, or discharge. Supports EMTALA compliance and HIPAA-compliant notification workflows.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); Epic Registration

attributes.name: phi_disclosure_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has authorized this contact to receive Protected Health Information (PHI) about their care. Critical for HIPAA compliance — clinical staff must verify this flag before disclosing any PHI to the contact. True = authorized; False = not authorized.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); OCR HIPAA Guidance; Epic Registration

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the emergency contact's address. Supports mail delivery, geographic segmentation, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) analysis.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS ZIP Code Standards; CMS SDOH Reporting

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The contact's preferred communication channel for receiving notifications and messages. Drives automated notification routing in care coordination and discharge planning workflows.
attributes.references: TJC Patient-Centered Communication Standards; TCPA; Epic Registration

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The contact's preferred spoken/written language for communication, expressed as a BCP-47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-CN'). Used to arrange interpreter services and ensure effective communication during emergency notifications and care coordination.
attributes.references: Section 1557 of the ACA (Language Access); TJC RC.02.01.01; HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.communication; CMS Meaningful Access Requirements

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the emergency contact prefers to be called, which may differ from their legal name. Supports patient-centered communication and cultural sensitivity in care coordination.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TJC Patient-Centered Communication Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: priority_order

attributes.name: proxy_document_type

attributes.name: source_system_contact_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this emergency contact record in the originating source system (e.g., Epic contact ID, Cerner relationship ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation, ETL traceability, and Health Information Exchange (HIE) matching.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Identifier; HITRUST CSF; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the emergency contact's address. Follows USPS state abbreviation standards. Used for geographic reporting and jurisdictional compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS State Abbreviations; Epic Registration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data loading in the Silver Layer lakehouse architecture.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); HITRUST CSF Control 09.ab; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Epic Registration

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member who last verified the accuracy of this emergency contact's information. Supports accountability and data quality governance in the patient registration process.
attributes.references: TJC RC.01.02.01; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Registration

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the emergency contact's information was verified with the patient or the contact directly. Supports data quality management and ensures contact information is current for emergency use.
attributes.references: TJC RC.01.02.01; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Business or workplace phone number for the emergency contact. Used during daytime hours when the contact may be reached at their place of employment. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA; Epic Registration

attributes.name: work_phone_extension
attributes.description: Extension number associated with the contact's work phone. Required for routing calls within large organizations where the contact is employed.
attributes.references: Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

SSOT for care team assignment used in population health, HEDIS, MIPS, and value-based care reporting. Sourced from population health management and payer attribution feeds.
