attributes.name: aco_contract_number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract number for the Accountable Care Organization (ACO) governing this attribution. Required for CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) reporting, shared savings reconciliation, and regulatory submissions to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) Final Rule 42 CFR Part 425

attributes.name: attributed_provider_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the attributed Primary Care Physician (PCP) or care team lead as registered with the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES). Required for HEDIS, MIPS, and CMS value-based care reporting submissions.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; NPPES; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: attribution_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the statistical confidence level of the attribution assignment. Higher scores indicate stronger evidence of the patient-PCP relationship based on visit frequency, claims history, or enrollment data. Used to prioritize manual review of low-confidence attributions and to weight population health analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Population Health Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to assign the patient to the PCP or care team. Claims-based attribution uses historical utilization patterns; enrollment-based uses payer plan enrollment data; manual is provider-assigned; algorithm-based uses predictive models; hybrid combines multiple methods; empanelment is practice-panel assignment. Drives HEDIS, MIPS, and ACO reporting logic.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA MIPS Attribution Rules

attributes.name: attribution_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason when an attribution assignment has been manually overridden from the algorithm-generated or payer-assigned attribution. Documents the clinical or administrative justification for the override, supporting audit trails and compliance with CMS and NCQA attribution integrity requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank (1 = primary) when a patient has multiple concurrent attribution records across different payers or plans. Rank 1 designates the primary PCP attribution used for population health management and HEDIS reporting. Higher ranks indicate secondary or supplemental attributions.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: attribution_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or completed date for the next periodic review of this attribution record. Attribution records are reviewed quarterly or annually per payer contract requirements to ensure accuracy of panel rosters and compliance with HEDIS and MIPS reporting periods.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_segment
attributes.description: Insurance coverage segment of the attributed patient. Determines applicable attribution methodology, quality measure set, and regulatory reporting requirements. Dual eligible patients (Medicare and Medicaid) require special attribution handling per CMS duals coordination rules.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare-Medicaid Coordination Office; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this attribution record was sourced. Identifies whether the attribution originated from Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner Millennium, a payer attribution feed, manual entry, HL7 FHIR interface, or a population health management platform. Critical for data lineage and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Provenance Resource; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: attribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PCP attribution record. Active indicates a current, valid attribution; pending indicates awaiting confirmation; disputed indicates a payer or provider challenge; terminated indicates the attribution period has ended; under_review indicates compliance or audit review in progress.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: care_management_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attributed patient is currently enrolled in a care management or disease management program under the attributed PCP or ACO. True = enrolled in care management. Used for population health program tracking and HEDIS care management measure reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Care Management (CCM) Billing Guidelines; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Quality Measures

attributes.name: consent_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has provided documented consent for their health information to be shared with the attributed PCP, care team, and ACO for care coordination and population health management purposes. Required for HIPAA-compliant data sharing under ACO and HIE participation agreements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.506; CMS ACO Beneficiary Notification Requirements; HL7 FHIR Consent Resource

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PCP attribution record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and compliance with HIPAA audit control standards. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: data_sharing_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has exercised their right to opt out of data sharing with the ACO or population health program under CMS beneficiary notification and opt-out requirements. True = patient has opted out. Patients who opt out must be excluded from ACO attribution and shared data feeds.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Beneficiary Notification and Opt-Out Requirements 42 CFR Part 425; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522

attributes.name: disenrollment_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for the termination of the PCP attribution. Used for panel management analytics, provider turnover reporting, and population health program evaluation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: provider_change|plan_disenrollment|patient_request|provider_termination|death|moved_out_of_area|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the PCP attribution becomes effective and the patient is considered part of the attributed provider's panel. Used as the start boundary for HEDIS measurement periods, MIPS performance calculations, and ACO shared savings attribution windows.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA Final Rule

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the PCP attribution terminates. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active attribution. Used to calculate attribution duration, panel turnover, and to exclude patients from measurement periods after disenrollment or provider change.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service area associated with this attribution record, typically aligned with CMS Hospital Referral Regions (HRR) or payer-defined service areas. Used for population health geographic analysis, regional quality benchmarking, and ACO regional benchmark calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Referral Region (HRR) Definitions; CMS MSSP Regional Benchmark Methodology

attributes.name: hcc_risk_score
attributes.description: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment score for the attributed patient at the time of attribution. Used in Medicare Advantage and ACO shared savings calculations to adjust expected expenditures for patient complexity. Sourced from CMS risk adjustment data or population health platform.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model; CMS Medicare Advantage Final Rule; CMS MSSP Shared Savings Program

attributes.name: hedis_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribution record qualifies the patient for inclusion in HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) measure calculations for the current measurement year. Eligibility is determined by continuous enrollment criteria, plan type, and attribution method per NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Program

tag_set.value: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: is_primary_attribution
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribution record is the patient's primary PCP attribution used as the single source of truth (SSOT) for population health management, HEDIS measurement, and MIPS performance reporting. True = primary attribution; False = secondary or supplemental attribution.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA MIPS Attribution Rules

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualifying primary care visit between the patient and the attributed PCP within the attribution lookback period. Used to assess recency of the patient-provider relationship and to support attribution validation and panel management.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: lookback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months in the historical claims lookback window used to determine claims-based attribution. Standard values are 12 or 24 months per CMS and NCQA attribution methodologies. Stored to support audit and reproducibility of attribution assignments.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this attribution record is applicable for quality measurement reporting (HEDIS, MIPS, ACO quality measures). Attribution records are typically finalized at the start of each measurement year and used throughout the performance period.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS MIPS Performance Period; CMS MSSP Measurement Year

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attributed provider qualifies for Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) performance measurement under MACRA for this attribution record. Eligibility is based on provider NPI, patient volume thresholds, and billing thresholds per CMS MIPS eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: MACRA Final Rule 42 CFR Part 414; CMS MIPS Eligibility Criteria; CMS QPP

tag_set.value: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: override_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manual attribution override was authorized and applied. Used in conjunction with override_authorized_by and attribution_override_reason to maintain a complete audit trail of attribution changes.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls

attributes.name: panel_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was formally added to the attributed PCP's patient panel in the practice management or population health system (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet empanelment). May differ from the attribution effective date when payer attribution and practice empanelment are managed separately.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet Panel Management; CMS ACO Attribution Methodology; NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: payer_attribution_number
attributes.description: The external attribution identifier assigned by the payer or managed care organization in their attribution feed. Used to reconcile internal attribution records with payer-issued attribution rosters and to resolve attribution disputes with payers.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; ERA/EDI 835 Transaction

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the health insurance payer or managed care organization that issued the attribution assignment. Used for payer-specific attribution reconciliation, HEDIS reporting submissions, and value-based contract performance tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Payer Enrollment Standards; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health insurance plan governing this attribution relationship. Accountable Care Organization (ACO), Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Point of Service (POS), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), or Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH). Determines attribution methodology and performance measurement rules.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Participation Agreement; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Plan Types

attributes.name: risk_stratification_tier
attributes.description: Patient risk stratification tier assigned at the time of attribution, based on clinical complexity, chronic condition burden, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) factors. attributes.references: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Model; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Population Health Guidance

attributes.name: sdoh_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has documented Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) risk factors (e.g., food insecurity, housing instability, transportation barriers) that require care coordination support from the attributed PCP or care team. True = SDOH risk factors present.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: visit_count_lookback
attributes.description: Number of qualifying primary care visits with the attributed provider during the claims-based attribution lookback period (typically 24 months). attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: referral_required

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the rejection reason returned by the payer or clearinghouse when the eligibility inquiry failed. Supports staff workflow resolution and denial prevention.

attributes.name: response_timestamp

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The date of service for which eligibility is being verified. May be the date of an upcoming appointment or the date of a completed encounter. Used to confirm coverage was active on the specific date of care.

products.name: patient_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment and coverage relationship between a patient (MPI record) and a health insurance plan. It captures the complete lifecycle of insurance coverage including enrollment periods, member identification, coordination of benefits priority, coverage tier, and relationship to the primary subscriber. Each record represents one patient's enrollment in one health plan during a specific time period, supporting scenarios where patients have multiple concurrent coverages (e.g., dual Medicare/Medicaid, COB scenarios) or sequential coverages over time (job changes, plan switches). This is the authoritative source for coverage verification, eligibility determination, and claims adjudication routing.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, patients routinely have multiple health plan coverages simultaneously (dual Medicare/Medicaid eligibility, primary employer coverage plus spouse's plan for COB, retiree supplemental coverage) and sequentially over time (job changes, aging into Medicare, Medicaid eligibility changes). Each health plan covers thousands to millions of patients. The business actively manages these coverage relationships as operational records with specific enrollment periods, member IDs per plan, COB priority sequencing, coverage tier assignments, and eligibility verification workflows.

domains.name: encounter
domains.description: Core operational record of every patient-provider interaction. Owns ADT (Admit, Discharge, Transfer) events, visit types (inpatient, outpatient, ED, observation, telehealth), admission source and disposition, attending and consulting providers, LOS (Length of Stay), DRG assignment, discharge status, and care setting transitions. Central hub linking patient, provider, clinical, and billing domains.
domains.references: HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource, HL7 ADT Messages, UB-04, CMS-1500

products.name: visit
products.description: Core master record for every patient-provider interaction across all care settings (inpatient, outpatient, ED, observation, telehealth, ambulatory). Central hub of the encounter domain and primary linkage point to patient, provider, clinical, and billing domains. Captures visit type, care setting, facility, attending provider, financial class, and visit status. Owns the full admission-through-discharge lifecycle: admission type (elective, urgent, emergent, newborn, trauma), admission source (ED, direct, transfer, referral, birth), admitting diagnosis, admitting provider, insurance verification at admission, admission and discharge timestamps, discharge disposition (home, SNF, rehab, AMA, expired, hospice, transfer), discharging provider, discharge instructions issued, discharge diagnosis summary, LOS (Length of Stay), readmission risk score, follow-up scheduling, and care transition plan. For observation encounters: two-midnight rule compliance assessment, MOON (Medicare Outpatient Observation Notice) delivery timestamp, total observation hours, conversion-to-inpatient flag and timestamp, and financial impact assessment. For telehealth encounters: platform, connection quality, and session metadata. Includes EMTALA compliance flags, consent status at admission, DRG assignment reference, CMI contribution, and financial class. SSOT for all encounter-level identity, classification, lifecycle state, admission, discharge, observation management, and care setting attributes.

products.name: adt_event
products.description: Transactional record of every ADT (Admit, Discharge, Transfer) event and care setting transition associated with a visit. Captures event type (A01 Admit, A02 Transfer, A03 Discharge, A08 Update, A11 Cancel Admit, etc.), event timestamp, sending and receiving units/beds, responsible provider at time of event, and HL7 ADT message metadata. For transfer and care transition events: origin and destination care settings, transition type (inter-unit, level-of-care change, inter-facility), transport mode, clinical reason for transition, accepting provider NPI, patient stability score at time of transfer, and EMTALA transfer compliance documentation. SSOT for all timestamped ADT events and care setting transitions within the encounter domain. No separate care_transition product exists — all transition data lives here. Enables real-time bed management, LOS milestone tracking, care transitions analysis, transitions-of-care quality measures, and readmission risk tracking. Sourced from Epic ADT and Cerner Millennium ADT feeds.

attributes.name: diagnosis_rank
attributes.description: Clinical ranking of this diagnosis by severity or clinical significance within the encounter, as assigned by the coding team or clinical documentation system. Distinct from diagnosis_seq_num (billing sequence); this rank reflects clinical priority for care management and quality reporting purposes.
attributes.references: AHIMA Clinical Documentation Improvement; 3M HIS CDI; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: diagnosis_seq_num
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this diagnosis within the encounter's diagnosis list. Sequence 1 typically denotes the principal diagnosis. Used for claim form ordering (UB-04 diagnosis fields), DRG grouping logic, and quality measure attribution. Aligns with LINE_SEQUENCE canonical category.
attributes.references: CMS UHDDS; UB-04 Claim Form FL 67; CMS-1500 Box 21; 3M HIS Grouper

attributes.name: diagnosis_source
attributes.description: Identifies who or what originated this diagnosis record. 'physician' = entered by the treating clinician; 'coder' = assigned by HIM coding staff; 'cdi_specialist' = added via CDI query resolution; 'system' = auto-populated by clinical decision support; 'imported' = received via HIE or external system. Supports audit trail and coding accountability.
attributes.references: AHIMA CDI Practice Standards; OIG Compliance; HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.recorder; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: diagnosis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the diagnosis role within the encounter. 'admitting' is the reason for admission; 'principal' is the condition chiefly responsible for the stay after study; 'secondary' are comorbidities and complications; 'discharge' is the final coded diagnosis at discharge; 'working' is a provisional diagnosis during the encounter; 'final' is the confirmed diagnosis post-workup. Drives DRG assignment and UB-04/CMS-1500 claim form population.
attributes.references: CMS Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS); UB-04 Claim Form; CMS-1500; UHDDS Principal Diagnosis Definition

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The MS-DRG or APR-DRG code assigned to the encounter as influenced by this diagnosis. Populated after DRG grouping by 3M HIS or CMS grouper. Central to inpatient reimbursement under IPPS and case mix index (CMI) calculation.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M APR-DRG Grouper; CMS IPPS; UB-04 FL 71

attributes.name: drg_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code contributes to the DRG assignment for this encounter. True = this diagnosis is a complication/comorbidity (CC) or major complication/comorbidity (MCC) that affects DRG grouping and reimbursement. Critical for revenue cycle optimization and CDI program targeting.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; 3M APR-DRG; CMS IPPS; UHDDS CC/MCC Definitions

attributes.name: drg_type
attributes.description: Specifies the DRG classification system used: MS-DRG (Medicare Severity DRG, CMS), APR-DRG (All Patient Refined DRG, 3M), or IR-DRG (International Refined DRG). Determines the reimbursement methodology and payer applicability.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG; 3M APR-DRG; WHO IR-DRG; CMS IPPS

attributes.name: encounter_diagnosis_comment
attributes.description: Free-text clinical comment or qualifier associated with this diagnosis record, as entered by the coding team or clinician. May include specificity notes, CDI query resolution rationale, or coding clarifications. Classified as restricted PHI per HIPAA.

attributes.name: encounter_diagnosis_source_code

attributes.name: external_cause_code

attributes.name: hai_flag

attributes.name: hcc_category_code

attributes.name: acuity_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or structured reason documented by the triage nurse when the ESI acuity level is changed during a reassessment. PHI under HIPAA. Used for clinical quality review and patient safety event analysis.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Joint Commission NPSG; AHRQ ED Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: ama_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient left the ED Against Medical Advice (AMA) after triage but before completing the full ED visit. Distinct from LWBS — AMA occurs after provider contact. Used for risk management, quality reporting, and EMTALA compliance.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; Joint Commission; CMS Conditions of Participation; AMA Policy

attributes.name: arrival_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the patient arrived at the ED or urgent care facility. Includes ground ambulance, air transport (helicopter), walk-in, police transport, private vehicle, or inter-facility transfer. Used for EMTALA compliance, acuity benchmarking, and EMS coordination analytics.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; UB-04 FL 38; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: chief_complaint
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the patient's primary reason for presenting to the ED or urgent care, as stated by the patient or documented by the triage nurse. Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA. Used for clinical documentation, coding, and population health analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter.reasonCode; ICD-10-CM Guidelines

attributes.name: diastolic_bp_mmhg
attributes.description: Diastolic blood pressure measurement recorded at triage, expressed in millimeters of mercury (mmHg). Used alongside systolic BP for hemodynamic assessment and ESI acuity scoring. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 8462-4; Joint Commission NPSG; AHA Clinical Guidelines

attributes.name: door_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the patient physically arrived at the ED or urgent care facility (door time). Used as the baseline for door-to-triage and door-to-provider time quality measures reported to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS ED Throughput Quality Measures; EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; Joint Commission

attributes.name: esi_level
attributes.description: Emergency Severity Index (ESI) triage acuity score assigned by the triage nurse, ranging from 1 (most critical/immediate) to 5 (least urgent/non-urgent). Drives resource allocation, bed assignment priority, and ED throughput analytics. Defined by AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm.
attributes.references: AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4; CMS ED Quality Measures; Joint Commission

attributes.name: glasgow_coma_score
attributes.description: Total Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score assessed at triage, ranging from 3 (deep unconsciousness) to 15 (fully alert). Used for neurological status assessment, ESI acuity determination, and trauma triage protocols. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 35088-4; AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4; ACS Trauma Guidelines

attributes.name: heart_rate_bpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heart Rate (HR) in Beats Per Minute (BPM)
attributes.description: Heart rate (pulse) measured at triage, expressed in beats per minute (BPM). Key vital sign for ESI acuity determination and identification of hemodynamic instability. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 8867-4; AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4

tag_set.value: Heart Rate (HR) in Beats Per Minute (BPM)

attributes.name: interpreter_language
attributes.description: Primary language for which interpretation services are required, using ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'zh' for Chinese). Supports LEP compliance reporting and interpreter resource planning.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; CMS LEP Policy; Title VI Civil Rights Act; HHS Office for Civil Rights

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient requires language interpretation services during the triage assessment. Supports compliance with Title VI of the Civil Rights Act and CMS Limited English Proficiency (LEP) requirements.
attributes.references: Title VI Civil Rights Act; CMS LEP Policy; Joint Commission RI Standards; HHS Office for Civil Rights

attributes.name: isolation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient requires isolation precautions at triage (e.g., airborne, droplet, contact, or neutropenic precautions). Drives bed assignment workflows, infection control protocols, and Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) prevention measures.
attributes.references: CDC Isolation Precautions Guidelines; Joint Commission IC Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens Standard

attributes.name: isolation_type
attributes.description: Type of isolation precaution required for the patient as determined at triage. Drives room assignment, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and infection control workflows.
attributes.references: CDC Isolation Precautions Guidelines 2007; Joint Commission IC Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: lwbs_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient left the ED without being seen by a provider after triage (LWBS). Key ED throughput quality metric reported to CMS and used for EMTALA compliance monitoring and operational improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; CMS ED Throughput Quality Measures; Joint Commission; AHRQ

attributes.name: lwbs_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the patient departed the ED without being seen by a provider, when the LWBS flag is true. Used to calculate time-to-LWBS and identify peak demand periods contributing to patient walkouts.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; CMS ED Throughput Quality Measures; Joint Commission

attributes.name: mental_health_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's chief complaint or triage assessment involves a primary mental health or behavioral health concern. Used for ED behavioral health throughput analytics, psychiatric bed management, and EMTALA psychiatric screening compliance.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; CMS Behavioral Health Integration; Joint Commission BHC Standards; SAMHSA

attributes.name: pain_scale_type
attributes.description: Type of validated pain assessment scale used to obtain the pain score at triage. Distinguishes between numeric rating scale (NRS), Wong-Baker FACES (pediatric), FLACC (non-verbal), verbal descriptor, or behavioral observation scales.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Pain Management Standards; AHRQ; Epic ClinDoc ED Module

attributes.name: pain_score
attributes.description: Patient-reported pain intensity score at triage, typically on a 0–10 numeric rating scale (NRS) or equivalent validated scale (e.g., Wong-Baker FACES for pediatric patients). Used for ESI acuity determination and Joint Commission pain management compliance. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 72514-3; Joint Commission Pain Management Standards; AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this triage assessment record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this triage assessment record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: respiratory_rate_bpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Respiratory Rate (RR) in Breaths Per Minute
attributes.description: Respiratory rate measured at triage, expressed in breaths per minute. Used for ESI acuity scoring and identification of respiratory distress. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 9279-1; AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4

tag_set.value: Respiratory Rate (RR) in Breaths Per Minute

attributes.name: sepsis_alert_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a sepsis screening alert was triggered at triage based on vital signs and clinical criteria (e.g., SIRS criteria, qSOFA). Supports SEP-1 bundle compliance reporting to CMS and Joint Commission sepsis quality measures.
attributes.references: CMS SEP-1 Quality Measure; Joint Commission Sepsis Standards; Surviving Sepsis Campaign Guidelines; AHRQ

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Epic ClinDoc or Cerner PowerChart ED) for this triage assessment. Enables cross-system traceability and supports Health Information Exchange (HIE) reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HL7 FHIR R4 Identifier; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: spo2_percent
attributes.description: Peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2) measured by pulse oximetry at triage, expressed as a percentage. Critical indicator for respiratory status and ESI acuity level assignment. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 59408-5; AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4; Joint Commission NPSG

attributes.name: stroke_alert_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a stroke alert protocol was activated at triage based on presenting symptoms (e.g., FAST criteria). Supports door-to-CT and door-to-needle time quality measures for stroke care reported to The Joint Commission and CMS.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Stroke Certification Standards; CMS Stroke Quality Measures; AHA/ASA Stroke Guidelines

attributes.name: systolic_bp_mmhg
attributes.description: Systolic blood pressure measurement recorded at triage, expressed in millimeters of mercury (mmHg). Critical vital sign for ESI acuity determination and clinical decision support. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 8480-6; Joint Commission NPSG; AHA Clinical Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Body temperature measured at triage, expressed in degrees Celsius. Used for ESI acuity determination, sepsis screening, and infection surveillance. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 8310-5; AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm v4; CDC Sepsis Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_route
attributes.description: Anatomical route used to obtain the body temperature measurement at triage (e.g., oral, rectal, axillary, tympanic, temporal). Affects clinical interpretation of temperature values.
attributes.references: LOINC 8327-9; Epic ClinDoc ED Module; Cerner PowerChart ED

attributes.name: trauma_activation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a trauma team activation was initiated at or following triage. Used for trauma registry reporting, ACS trauma center verification, and ED resource utilization analytics.
attributes.references: ACS Committee on Trauma; Joint Commission Trauma Standards; State Trauma Registry Requirements

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: Level of trauma team activation triggered at triage (Level 1 = full activation for most critical injuries, Level 2 = partial activation, Level 3 = consult/standby). Drives resource deployment and trauma registry classification.
attributes.references: ACS Committee on Trauma; State Trauma Registry Requirements; Joint Commission Trauma Standards

attributes.name: triage_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of triage acuity corresponding to the ESI level. Supports ED throughput reporting, staffing models, and payer analytics. Values align with standard ED triage nomenclature.
attributes.references: AHRQ ESI Triage Algorithm; CMS ED Throughput Measures; Joint Commission

attributes.name: triage_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the triage assessment was fully documented and completed by the triage nurse. Used to calculate triage duration and nurse productivity metrics.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc ED Module; CMS ED Throughput Measures

attributes.name: triage_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for the triage assessment record as assigned by the source system (Epic ClinDoc or Cerner PowerChart ED). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc ED Module; Cerner PowerChart ED

attributes.name: triage_nurse_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the licensed nurse or clinician who performed the triage assessment. Required for EMTALA compliance documentation and provider-level quality reporting. Sourced from Epic ClinDoc or Cerner PowerChart ED.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR §162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: triage_reassessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this triage record represents a reassessment of a previously triaged patient (e.g., patient condition changed while waiting). Supports tracking of acuity escalation events and waiting room safety monitoring.
attributes.references: Joint Commission NPSG; AHRQ ED Safety Guidelines; Epic ClinDoc ED Module

attributes.name: triage_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the triage assessment record. Indicates whether triage documentation is in progress, finalized, subsequently amended, or voided.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc ED Module; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter.status

attributes.name: triage_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the triage assessment was initiated by the triage nurse. This is the principal business event timestamp used to calculate door-to-triage time and ED throughput quality measures.
attributes.references: CMS ED Throughput Quality Measures; EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; Joint Commission NPSG

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Patient weight measured or reported at triage, expressed in kilograms. Used for medication dosing calculations, pediatric weight-based protocols, and clinical decision support. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; LOINC 29463-7; Joint Commission Medication Management Standards

SSOT for provider identity and authorization.

products.name: clinician
products.description: Master record for all individual healthcare professionals including physicians, nurses, allied health professionals, and advanced practice providers. Serves as the SSOT for provider identity, NPI (National Provider Identifier), DEA number, professional demographics, primary specialty, and employment type. Includes complete educational background and postgraduate training history as embedded detail records: medical school, residency programs, fellowship training, and internships with institution name, program type, degree or certificate awarded, graduation/completion date, ACGME accreditation status, and primary source verification status. No other product in this domain stores education or training history. Sourced from Epic EHR provider master and Symplr credentialing system.

attributes.name: short_description

attributes.name: specialty_type

products.name: privileging

Captures privilege category, procedure list, granting facility, privilege status (active, provisional, suspended, revoked), effective and expiration dates, and approving medical staff committee. Core to EMTALA compliance and Joint Commission accreditation.

attributes.name: privileging_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each clinical privileging record granted to a clinician at a specific facility. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.credentialing_application. Business justification: Clinical privileges are the formal outcome of a credentialing application process. attributes.name: privileging_clinician_id

tag_set.value: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Required Indicator

attributes.name: peer_review_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or rating assigned during the most recent peer review or focused professional practice evaluation (FPPE) or ongoing professional practice evaluation (OPPE) for this privilege. Used to support reappointment decisions. Sensitive business-confidential data.

attributes.name: privilege_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the privilege type granted. Clinical covers general patient care; surgical covers operative procedures; procedural covers invasive non-surgical acts; diagnostic covers imaging/interpretation; prescriptive covers medication authority; administrative covers leadership roles.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: privilege_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope and limitations of the clinical privilege, including any conditions, supervision requirements, or volume thresholds specified by the medical staff committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: privilege_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the clinical privilege granted (e.g., 'Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy', 'Cardiac Catheterization', 'Endotracheal Intubation'). Sourced from the facility's approved privilege delineation form.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; AMA CPT Coding Standards

attributes.name: privilege_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the medical staff office to uniquely reference this privileging grant. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and credentialing system lookups (e.g., Symplr privilege record number).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: privilege_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the clinical privilege grant. Active indicates full authorization; provisional indicates supervised practice during initial period; suspended indicates temporary removal pending investigation; revoked indicates permanent removal; expired indicates lapsed without renewal; pending indicates awaiting committee approval.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22; EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24

attributes.name: privilege_type
attributes.description: Specific classification of the privilege grant. Core privileges are standard for the specialty; special privileges require additional training; temporary privileges are time-limited; telemedicine covers remote care delivery; locum tenens covers temporary coverage providers; disaster privileges are emergency-activated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|special|temporary|telemedicine|locum_tenens|disaster|provisional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: provisional_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the provisional privilege period ends and the clinician transitions to full privileges, contingent on satisfactory proctoring evaluation. Null when privilege is not provisional.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: reappointment_cycle_years
attributes.description: Number of years in the medical staff reappointment cycle for this privilege (typically 2 years per TJC standards). Determines the frequency of privilege renewal and competency review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinician submitted the privilege request or reappointment application to the medical staff office. Used to track processing turnaround time and compliance with credentialing timelines.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: required_case_volume
attributes.description: Minimum number of cases or procedures the clinician must perform within the privilege period to demonstrate competency and maintain the privilege. Set by the medical staff committee based on specialty standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was permanently revoked, if applicable. Null when privilege has not been revoked. Triggers mandatory NPDB adverse action report within 15 days.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for permanent privilege revocation, such as gross negligence, criminal conviction, license revocation, or sustained peer review findings. Sensitive business-confidential information required for NPDB adverse action reporting.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; OIG Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this privileging record in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr privilege record ID, Epic credentialing record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this privileging record originated (e.g., SYMPLR for Symplr Credentialing, EPIC for Epic OpTime/Cadence, CERNER for Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH for MEDITECH Expanse, MANUAL for paper-based entry).
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was suspended, if applicable. Null when privilege has never been suspended. Required for adverse action reporting to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB).
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for privilege suspension, such as patient safety concern, peer review finding, license lapse, or investigation pending. Sensitive business-confidential information used for adverse action documentation and NPDB reporting.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; OIG Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: telemedicine_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this privilege extends to telemedicine or telehealth delivery of the authorized services. True when the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged activity via remote/virtual care modalities.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Telemedicine Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.12(a)(8); State Telehealth Laws

products.name: credentialing_application
products.description: Transactional record of a clinician's formal application for medical staff membership and clinical privileges at a facility, covering the complete credentialing lifecycle: initial credentialing, biennial reappointment, and privilege expansion workflows. Tracks application type, submission date, status, and all verification stages including: (1) Primary source verification of licenses, education, and training; (2) Peer reference evaluations with referee identity, NPI, relationship to applicant, competency ratings, professional conduct assessment, recommendation type, and confidentiality flag; (3) NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank) queries with query type (initial, reappointment, continuous query enrollment), query/response dates, response status, adverse action flags, malpractice payment flags, and query reference number; (4) Malpractice insurance verification with insurer name, policy number, coverage type (occurrence vs. claims-made), per-occurrence and aggregate limits, effective/expiration dates, tail coverage indicator, and coverage status; (5) Reappointment cycle management with review period tracking, peer review summaries, quality indicator results, CME compliance status, renewal decisions, and reappointment effective dates. Records committee review dates, final approval/denial decision, and effective dates. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for the entire credentialing lifecycle workflow — no other product in this domain stores peer references, NPDB queries, malpractice verification, or reappointment cycle data. Compliant with NCQA, Joint Commission, CAQH, and CMS credentialing standards. Sourced from Symplr credentialing workflow.
products.reference: NCQA Credentialing Standards, URAC, Joint Commission

attributes.description: The DEA registration number authorizing the provider to prescribe controlled substances. Verified as part of primary source verification. Required for providers with prescribing privileges. Format: two letters followed by seven digits.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical executive committee or credentialing committee rendered the final approval or denial decision on the application.

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: The final disposition rendered by the credentialing committee: approved for full privileges, denied, deferred pending additional information, withdrawn by the applicant, or provisional privileges granted pending full review.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the reason for denial or deferral of the credentialing application. Populated only when decision_type is denied or deferred. Confidential per medical staff bylaws and peer review protection statutes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which approved clinical privileges and medical staff membership become effective, authorizing the provider to practice at the facility. Used for payer enrollment and billing authorization alignment.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the granted clinical privileges and medical staff membership expire, typically 24 months from the effective date per biennial reappointment cycles. Triggers reappointment workflow initiation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.07; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: malpractice_aggregate_limit
attributes.description: The maximum total dollar amount the malpractice insurance policy will pay for all covered claims during the policy period. Expressed in USD. Facilities typically require minimum aggregate limits (e.g., $3,000,000 aggregate).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of professional liability insurance policy: occurrence-based coverage (covers incidents occurring during the policy period regardless of when the claim is filed) or claims-made coverage (covers claims filed while the policy is active, requiring tail coverage upon expiration).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; ACMQ (American College of Medical Quality)

attributes.name: malpractice_insurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the professional liability (malpractice) insurance carrier providing coverage for the applicant. Verified as part of the credentialing process to confirm active coverage.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_per_occurrence_limit
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount the malpractice insurance policy will pay for a single covered claim or occurrence. Expressed in USD. Facilities typically require minimum limits (e.g., $1,000,000 per occurrence).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current professional liability insurance policy became effective. Used to confirm continuous coverage and identify any gaps.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current professional liability insurance policy expires. Triggers re-verification and alerts when approaching expiration to ensure continuous coverage.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the professional liability insurance policy covering the applicant. Used for verification with the insurer and for audit documentation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: medical_staff_category
attributes.description: The category of medical staff membership being applied for, defining the provider's rights, responsibilities, and voting privileges within the medical staff organization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|associate|courtesy|consulting|honorary|provisional|affiliate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.01.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB response contains one or more medical malpractice payment reports. True triggers mandatory committee review and documentation of the committee's assessment of the payment history.

tag_set.value: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Malpractice Payment Flag

attributes.name: npdb_query_date

attributes.name: psv_work_history_status

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the medical staff office officially received and logged the credentialing application. May differ from submission_date when applications are mailed or submitted through intermediaries such as CAQH ProView.

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.description: The date on which the provider enrollment application was formally submitted to the payer. Used to track application processing timelines, SLA compliance, and identify delayed enrollments impacting revenue.

attributes.name: credentialing_tier
attributes.description: Payer-assigned credentialing tier that may affect reimbursement rates, network designation, or quality incentive eligibility. Tier classifications vary by payer but generally reflect quality metrics, board certification, and practice standards. Sourced from Symplr credentialing module.

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number of the provider, required for enrollment with payers that cover controlled substance prescribing. Format: two letters followed by seven digits. Sensitive identifier subject to DEA regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: DEA Practitioner Registration; 21 CFR Part 1301; Symplr Credentialing Module

attributes.name: edi_submitter_code
attributes.description: The EDI submitter identifier assigned by the payer for electronic claims submission (HIPAA 837 transactions) under this enrollment. Required for electronic billing setup and clearinghouse routing.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's enrollment with the payer becomes effective and the provider is authorized to submit claims. Critical for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) to determine billable service dates.

attributes.name: eft_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has enrolled in Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) with this payer for direct deposit of claim payments. EFT enrollment is required by CMS for Medicare providers under the ACA. True = EFT active; False = paper check.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1104; CMS EFT Enrollment Requirements; NACHA EFT Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique enrollment reference number assigned by the payer or enrollment system (e.g., Symplr enrollment tracking number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and payer correspondence.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Provider Enrollment and Chain Ownership System (PECOS)

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The system or channel through which the enrollment application was submitted. 'Symplr' indicates submission via the Symplr provider enrollment module. 'PECOS' indicates direct submission via CMS Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System. Used for data lineage and process analytics.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS PECOS; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the provider's enrollment with the payer. 'Active' indicates the provider is credentialed and authorized to bill. 'Pending' indicates the application is under review. 'Terminated' indicates the enrollment has ended. 'Suspended' indicates temporary hold. 'Rejected' indicates the application was denied. 'Revalidation_required' indicates CMS-mandated periodic revalidation is due.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Revalidation; 42 CFR Part 424; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Indicates the nature of the provider's participation agreement with the payer. 'Participating' providers accept payer-negotiated rates as payment in full. 'Non-participating' providers may balance-bill patients. 'Opt-out' applies to Medicare providers who have formally opted out. 'Reassignment' indicates benefits are reassigned to a group or facility.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Participating Physician Program; 42 CFR Part 424; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: group_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit NPI of the group practice or organizational entity under which the individual provider is enrolled with this payer. Relevant for reassignment of benefits and group billing scenarios. Distinct from the individual provider's NPI.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS-855B Enrollment Form

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the state in which the provider holds the license submitted for this enrollment. Used to validate licensure jurisdiction against the payer's service area.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; USPS State Abbreviation Standard; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: medicaid_provider_number
attributes.description: State-assigned Medicaid provider identification number issued upon successful Medicaid enrollment. Required for Medicaid claims submission. Varies by state Medicaid program. Null for non-Medicaid enrollments.

attributes.name: network_status

attributes.name: provider_type

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_checked

attributes.name: service_address_line1

attributes.name: service_city

attributes.name: service_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the state where services are rendered under this enrollment. Used for state-specific billing rules, Medicaid jurisdiction, and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: service_zip_code

attributes.name: state_license_number

attributes.name: tax_identification_number

attributes.name: termination_date

'Sanction' indicates OIG or CMS exclusion. Required for compliance reporting and audit trails. Null for active enrollments. attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payer enrollment record was most recently modified in the source system (Symplr). Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform convention.

products.name: group

attributes.name: group_id

attributes.name: accepts_new_patients

attributes.name: aco_participant

attributes.name: admin_contact_email

attributes.name: billing_entity_name

attributes.name: billing_npi

attributes.name: contract_effective_date

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group's primary contract was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null if the contract is open-ended or currently active. Used for claims eligibility cutoff and network directory updates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group's current credentialing cycle expires and recredentialing must be completed. NCQA requires recredentialing at least every three years. Used to trigger recredentialing workflows in Symplr.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the provider group as maintained by the health system's medical staff office or delegated credentialing entity. attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: fqhc_designation

attributes.name: group_type

attributes.name: hl7_fhir_organization_reference
attributes.description: The FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) Organization resource ID for this provider group, used in HL7 FHIR R4 API exchanges with payers, HIEs (Health Information Exchanges), and external systems.
