attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; USPS Postal Standards

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the DEA registration was originally issued or most recently renewed by the Drug Enforcement Administration. Represents the effective start of the current registration period.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.13; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registration_state
attributes.description: The U.S. state or territory in which the DEA registration is valid and the provider is authorized to prescribe controlled substances. DEA registrations are state-specific; a provider practicing in multiple states requires a separate DEA registration for each state. Represented as a two-letter USPS state abbreviation.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DEA registration. Active indicates the registration is valid and the provider may prescribe controlled substances. Expired indicates the registration has lapsed and must be renewed before prescribing. Suspended or revoked indicates regulatory action has been taken.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration is held by an individual practitioner or by an institutional entity (e.g., hospital, clinic, pharmacy). Institutional registrations cover all authorized practitioners operating under the institution's DEA number.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider submitted a renewal application to the DEA for continuation of the controlled substance registration. DEA regulations require renewal applications to be submitted at least 45 days before expiration. Used for credentialing workflow tracking in Symplr.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.31; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: renewal_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation or tracking number issued by the DEA upon receipt of a renewal application. Used to track the status of pending renewals and follow up with the DEA Diversion Control Division.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.31; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DEA registration was formally revoked by the Drug Enforcement Administration. Revocation is a permanent action distinct from suspension. Null when the registration has not been revoked.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: schedule_ii_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule II controlled substances (e.g., opioids such as oxycodone, stimulants such as amphetamine). Schedule II substances have high abuse potential with severe psychological or physical dependence. Required for CPOE validation in Epic Willow and Cerner PharmNet.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.12; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_iii_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule III controlled substances (e.g., anabolic steroids, buprenorphine combinations). Schedule III substances have moderate to low physical dependence potential.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.13; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_iin_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule IIN non-narcotic controlled substances (e.g., stimulants such as methylphenidate, Adderall). Distinct from Schedule IIN narcotic authorizations for pharmacy dispensing and order validation purposes.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.12; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_iv_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule IV controlled substances (e.g., benzodiazepines, tramadol). Schedule IV substances have lower abuse potential relative to Schedule III.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.14; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_v_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule V controlled substances (e.g., cough preparations with less than 200mg of codeine per 100mL). Schedule V substances have the lowest abuse potential among controlled substances.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.15; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this DEA registration record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation across credentialing platforms.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier for this DEA registration in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr provider ID, Epic provider record number). Used for ETL reconciliation and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: surrender_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider voluntarily surrendered the DEA registration to the Drug Enforcement Administration. Voluntary surrender may occur upon retirement, change of practice, or in lieu of revocation proceedings.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.52; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DEA registration was suspended by the Drug Enforcement Administration or voluntarily surrendered by the provider. Null when the registration has not been suspended. Triggers immediate pharmacy order blocking in CPOE systems.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for suspension or revocation of the DEA registration, as documented by the DEA or the provider's credentialing department. Includes regulatory action codes, voluntary surrender reasons, or administrative hold explanations.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; OIG Exclusion Database

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the DEA registration was verified against the DEA Diversion Control Division public registry or through a primary source verification process. Required for Joint Commission and NCQA credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the DEA registration during the credentialing or re-credentialing process. DEA portal indicates direct query to the DEA Diversion Control Division online registry; primary source indicates direct contact with the DEA; third party indicates use of a credentialing verification organization (CVO).
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: x_waiver_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider holds a DATA 2000 waiver (formerly X-waiver) authorizing the prescribing of buprenorphine for opioid use disorder treatment in an office-based setting. As of the SUPPORT Act (2023), the X-waiver requirement was eliminated, but this flag tracks historical and current waiver status for compliance and analytics.
attributes.references: Drug Addiction Treatment Act of 2000 (DATA 2000); SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act (2018); DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; SAMHSA

attributes.name: x_waiver_patient_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of patients the provider is authorized to treat with buprenorphine for opioid use disorder under the DATA 2000 waiver. Common limits are 30, 100, or 275 patients depending on provider type and waiver tier. Null if x_waiver_authorized is false or not applicable.
attributes.references: Drug Addiction Treatment Act of 2000 (DATA 2000); SAMHSA; DEA Diversion Control Division

products.name: board_certification
products.description: Tracks specialty board certifications earned by clinicians from recognized certifying bodies (ABMS, AOA). Captures certifying board name, specialty certified, certification number, initial certification date, expiration date, maintenance of certification (MOC) status, and recertification history. Used in credentialing, provider directory, and quality reporting.
products.reference: ABMS (American Board of Medical Specialties), AOA

attributes.name: board_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each board certification record in the system. Primary key for the board_certification data product within the provider domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed healthcare professional (physician, nurse practitioner, or allied health professional) who holds this board certification. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.credentialing_application. Business justification: Board certifications are submitted during credentialing applications. FK will be NULL for certifications not tied to a specific application. No redundant columns to remove.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.specialty

attributes.name: caqh_provider_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Provider ID
attributes.description: The CAQH ProView universal provider identifier associated with the provider for this certification record. CAQH ProView is the industry-standard credentialing data repository used by payers and health plans for provider enrollment and re-credentialing. Enables direct linkage to the provider's CAQH profile.
attributes.references: CAQH ProView Credentialing Data Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

tag_set.value: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Provider ID

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric certificate number issued by the certifying board to the provider upon successful completion of board examination and certification requirements. Used as the externally-known business identifier for this certification record in credentialing and payer enrollment workflows.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA) Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the board certification. Active = valid and in good standing; Expired = past expiration date without renewal; Revoked = rescinded by certifying board due to disciplinary action or fraud; Suspended = temporarily inactive; Pending = examination passed but certificate not yet issued; Lapsed = MOC requirements not met within required window.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) Credentialing Standards MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record represents an initial board certification, a recertification cycle, an added qualification (subspecialty), or a Maintenance of Certification (MOC) milestone. Drives credentialing workflow routing and expiration tracking logic.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: certifying_board_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or abbreviation identifying the certifying board (e.g., ABIM for American Board of Internal Medicine, ABS for American Board of Surgery). Used in downstream credentialing systems and payer enrollment data exchanges.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); CAQH ProView Credentialing Data Standards

attributes.name: certifying_board_name
attributes.description: Full name of the recognized specialty certifying board that issued this certification (e.g., American Board of Internal Medicine, American Board of Surgery). Must be an ABMS member board or AOA-recognized certifying board for credentialing acceptance.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA); The Joint Commission (TJC) Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: certifying_organization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the umbrella organization under which the certifying board operates. ABMS = American Board of Medical Specialties (allopathic physicians), AOA = American Osteopathic Association (osteopathic physicians), ANCC = American Nurses Credentialing Center, AANP = American Association of Nurse Practitioners, AAPA = American Academy of Physician Associates.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA); American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this board certification record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data governance, lineage tracking, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current certification cycle or recertification became effective. For initial certifications this may equal initial_certification_date; for recertifications this reflects the start of the renewed certification period.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); CAQH ProView Credentialing Data Standards

attributes.name: exam_attempt_number
attributes.description: The sequential attempt number on which the provider passed the board certification examination. A value of 1 indicates first-attempt pass. Used in quality and credentialing analytics to assess examination performance.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Examination Policies

attributes.name: exam_pass_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider successfully passed the board certification examination administered by the certifying board. Distinct from initial_certification_date, which reflects when the certificate was formally issued.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); AOA Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current board certification expires and must be renewed through recertification or Maintenance of Certification (MOC). Null for lifetime certifications issued prior to time-limited certification policies. Critical for credentialing expiration alerts and payer enrollment compliance.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: initial_certification_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the provider first achieved board certification in this specialty from this certifying board. Represents the effective start of the agreement/credential. Used to calculate years of board certification and tenure in credentialing analytics.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: is_active_privileges_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether active hospital privileges in this specialty are required to be maintained in conjunction with this board certification per the organization's medical staff bylaws or credentialing policies.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR 482.22

attributes.name: is_lifetime_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this board certification was issued as a lifetime (non-time-limited) certificate, typically granted to physicians who achieved certification prior to the introduction of time-limited recertification requirements by ABMS member boards. When True, expiration_date is expected to be null.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Time-Limited Certification Policy

attributes.name: is_primary_specialty
attributes.description: Indicates whether this board certification represents the provider's primary specialty designation. A provider may hold multiple board certifications; this flag identifies the principal specialty used for provider directory listings, referral routing, and quality reporting.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS)

attributes.name: moc_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the provider must complete all required Maintenance of Certification (MOC) activities to maintain certification in good standing. Used for proactive credentialing alerts and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; The Joint Commission (TJC) Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: moc_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider enrolled in the Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program associated with this board certification. Used to track MOC program participation timelines and compliance windows.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program

attributes.name: moc_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program the provider is enrolled in for this certification (e.g., ABIM MOC, ABS Continuous Certification). Different boards operate distinct MOC programs with varying requirements.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program Directory

attributes.name: moc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's participation in the Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program as required by the certifying board. MOC programs require ongoing professional development, self-assessment, and practice improvement activities to maintain board certification in good standing.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff to capture supplementary information about this board certification record, such as special conditions, board correspondence details, or exceptions noted during primary source verification.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; Internal Credentialing Policy

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider holding this board certification, as assigned by CMS. Included here to support direct payer enrollment data submissions and provider directory feeds where the NPI must accompany certification data without requiring a join.
attributes.references: CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Standard; HIPAA Administrative Simplification 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this board certification is required as a condition of the provider's enrollment with one or more payers (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurers). Drives payer enrollment workflow triggers when certification status changes.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS); CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: recertification_cycle_years
attributes.description: The number of years in the recertification cycle for this board certification as defined by the certifying board (e.g., 10 years for ABIM, 6 years for ABS). Used to project next recertification due dates and plan credentialing renewal workflows.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Certification Policies

attributes.name: recertification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider most recently completed recertification for this specialty board certification. Null for initial certifications that have not yet undergone a recertification cycle.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certifying board formally revoked this board certification, if applicable. Null for certifications in good standing. Revocation may result from disciplinary action, fraud, or failure to meet MOC requirements. Triggers immediate credentialing review per OIG and TJC requirements.
attributes.references: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Database; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for revocation of this board certification by the certifying board, if applicable. Null for active certifications. Used in credentialing review, compliance reporting, and OIG exclusion monitoring.
attributes.references: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Database; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this board certification record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Symplr record ID, CAQH credential ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: subspecialty_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the subspecialty or added qualification certification, aligned with NUCC taxonomy or ABMS subspecialty codes. Null if no subspecialty applies to this certification record.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS)

attributes.name: subspecialty_name
attributes.description: Full name of the subspecialty or added qualification for which the provider holds certification, if applicable (e.g., Interventional Cardiology within Cardiology, Pediatric Critical Care within Pediatrics). Null if no subspecialty certification exists for this record.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Subspecialty List; AOA Subspecialty Certifications

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this board certification record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which primary source verification (PSV) of this board certification was most recently completed by contacting the certifying board directly or through an approved verification service (e.g., ABMS Certification Matters, CAQH). Required for TJC and NCQA credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The primary source or service used to verify this board certification (e.g., ABMS Certification Matters website, AOA Physician Finder, CAQH ProView, direct board contact). Documents the audit trail for credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the primary source verification (PSV) of this board certification as required by The Joint Commission and NCQA credentialing standards. Verified = confirmed directly with the certifying board; Pending Verification = PSV request submitted but not yet confirmed; Unable to Verify = certifying board could not confirm; Expired Verification = PSV is older than the required re-verification window.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03 Primary Source Verification; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; URAC Credentialing Standards

products.name: location
products.description: Master record of physical and virtual practice locations where clinicians and organizational providers deliver care. Captures address, location type (primary office, satellite clinic, hospital, telehealth-only, mobile unit), phone, fax, hours of operation, ADA accessibility indicator, accepting new patients flag, geolocation coordinates, CMS Place of Service code, and language capabilities. Supports provider directory publishing, network adequacy analysis, patient access reporting, and CMS provider enrollment location validation.
products.reference: CMS Provider Directory Requirements, 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each provider practice location record in the master provider location registry. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NPPES NPI Registry

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual clinician or organizational provider associated with this practice location. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NPPES NPI Registry

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_group. Business justification: Locations are associated with provider groups for billing. provider_location.billing_group_name should be FK to provider_group. Removes billing_group_name STRING.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: org_provider_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_updated_date

attributes.description: Date on which the accepting new patients status was last verified or updated. CMS requires this field to be refreshed at least every 90 days for network adequacy compliance and provider directory accuracy.

tag_set.value: Accepting New Patients Last Updated Date

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the practice location including street number and street name. Used for provider directory publishing, CMS enrollment validation, and patient navigation.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail such as suite number, floor, building name, or unit number for the practice location.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment; NPPES NPI Registry

attributes.name: after_hours_phone
attributes.description: Telephone number for reaching the practice location or on-call provider outside of regular business hours. Required for continuity of care and NCQA medical home standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: appointment_scheduling_url
attributes.description: Direct URL for online patient appointment scheduling at this location. Published in provider directories and patient portals to support patient self-scheduling and access.
attributes.references: CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule; 21st Century Cures Act; FHIR R4 Schedule Resource

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the practice location is physically situated. Used for geographic network adequacy analysis and provider directory search.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: cms_enrollment_number

attributes.description: CMS-assigned enrollment identifier (PTAN — Provider Transaction Access Number) for this practice location. Required for Medicare claims submission and CMS enrollment validation.

attributes.name: cms_place_of_service_code

attributes.description: Two-digit CMS Place of Service code identifying the setting where healthcare services are rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 02=Telehealth). Required on CMS-1500 professional claims and drives reimbursement rate determination.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Place of Service (POS) Code

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the practice location (e.g., USA). Supports international provider networks and cross-border care coordination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider location record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the provider at this location as tracked by the credentialing and privileging system (e.g., Symplr). Determines eligibility to render services and bill payers from this location.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: directory_last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider location information was last verified for accuracy in the provider directory. Supports CMS and NCQA provider directory accuracy requirements and audit trails.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR Part 438.10; NCQA Provider Directory Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider location record became or becomes operationally active. Used for CMS enrollment effective date validation, payer contract start alignment, and provider directory publication timing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR Part 424; CMS-855 Enrollment Application

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: General contact email address for the practice location. Used for administrative communications, referral coordination, and provider directory publishing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the practice location used for clinical communications, referral transmissions, and medical record exchange. Commonly required for HL7 ADT and referral workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; HL7 v2 ADT; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: hours_of_operation
attributes.description: Structured or free-text representation of the practice location's regular operating hours by day of week (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00, Sat 09:00-13:00'). Used in provider directories and patient access reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR Part 438; NCQA Provider Directory Standards

attributes.name: is_accepting_new_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider at this location is currently accepting new patients. Critical field for provider directory accuracy, CMS network adequacy compliance, and patient access reporting. CMS requires this to be updated at least every 90 days.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR Part 438.10; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: is_ada_accessible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location is physically accessible and compliant with Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requirements, including wheelchair access, accessible parking, and accessible restrooms.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Title III; CMS Provider Directory Requirements; Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

tag_set.value: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Indicator

attributes.name: is_primary_location
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the provider's primary practice location. Used to determine the principal address for CMS enrollment, claims adjudication, and provider directory primary listing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NPPES NPI Registry; CMS-1500 Claim Form

attributes.name: is_telehealth_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider at this location offers telehealth or virtual care services. Drives provider directory telehealth filtering and CMS Place of Service code 02 eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; 42 CFR Part 410.78; FHIR R4 Location Resource

attributes.name: language_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes representing languages spoken at this practice location (e.g., 'en|es|zh'). Supports patient language matching, CMS language access requirements, and CLAS Standards compliance.
attributes.references: National CLAS Standards (HHS); CMS Language Access Requirements; Title VI Civil Rights Act; ISO 639-1

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the practice location in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Enables geospatial network adequacy analysis, drive-time calculations, and patient access mapping.
attributes.references: WGS 84 Coordinate System; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; CMS Network Adequacy Final Rule

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the provider location. Determines whether the location is published in provider directories, eligible for patient scheduling, and included in network adequacy calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR Part 424; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the practice location describing the care delivery setting. Drives provider directory filtering, network adequacy analysis, and CMS Place of Service mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary_office|satellite_clinic|hospital|telehealth_only|mobile_unit|urgent_care|ambulatory_surgery_center|long_term_care|home_health|retail_clinic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes; 42 CFR Part 438; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the practice location in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Enables geospatial network adequacy analysis, drive-time calculations, and patient access mapping.

products.name: group_membership
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between individual clinicians and medical group practices. It captures the operational reality that clinicians can hold simultaneous memberships in multiple groups (e.g., a hospitalist employed by Group A while also holding privileges at Group B), and groups aggregate many clinicians under shared organizational identity. Each record links one clinician to one group with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific membership: effective dates, termination dates, membership role, employment classification within that group, primary group designation, and membership status.. Existence Justification: Clinician group membership is a fundamental operational relationship in healthcare provider management. In real-world healthcare operations, clinicians routinely hold simultaneous memberships in multiple medical groups (e.g., a cardiologist may be a partner in Cardiology Associates while also holding hospital-based privileges through Hospital Medicine Group for inpatient coverage). Conversely, medical groups aggregate many clinicians under shared organizational identity for contracting, credentialing, billing, and network participation. This relationship is actively managed by credentialing departments, provider enrollment teams, and payer contracting staff who maintain membership rosters with specific effective dates, roles, employment classifications, and status lifecycles.

products.name: vital_sign
products.description: Patient vital sign measurements captured during clinical encounters, nursing assessments, and continuous monitoring. Includes LOINC-coded observation types: blood pressure (systolic/diastolic), heart rate, respiratory rate, temperature, SpO2, height, weight, BMI, pain score, and Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS). Captures measured value, unit of measure, measurement method, body site, patient position, device used, measurement date/time, and recording clinician. Supports early warning score (EWS/MEWS/NEWS) calculations, sepsis screening, and clinical deterioration detection. High-volume time-series clinical data sourced from Epic ClinDoc flowsheets, Cerner PowerChart, and bedside monitoring device integrations. Separated from clinical_observation due to distinct high-frequency time-series ingestion patterns, dedicated device integration pipelines, and specialized analytics (trending, alerting, waveform correlation). Maps to FHIR Observation with vitals profile (US Core Vital Signs).

products.name: observation
products.description: SSOT for all structured clinical observations, assessments, scored evaluations, and clinical findings documented by clinicians during patient care. Encompasses LOINC-coded and SNOMED CT-coded observations across all clinical contexts including: nursing assessments (head-to-toe, skin integrity, restraint, fall risk using Morse/Braden scales, pressure injury staging, discharge readiness), functional status assessments (Barthel Index, FIM, ADL/IADL), behavioral health screenings (PHQ-9, CAGE-AID, Columbia Suicide Severity), SDOH screenings, wound assessments, intake/output measurements, neurological assessments (GCS components), physical examination findings, symptom documentation, and clinical impressions. Captures observation code, value (numeric, coded, or text), units, reference range, interpretation flag (normal, abnormal, critical), observation_category (nursing, functional, finding, screening, exam), assessment tool used, body system/site, laterality, severity, presence status (present, absent, unknown), observation date/time, and recording clinician. High-volume structured clinical data sourced from Epic ClinDoc flowsheets, Cerner PowerChart, and structured documentation modules. Supports nursing quality metrics, discharge planning, population health stratification, Joint Commission compliance, and FHIR Observation resource interoperability.

products.name: care_team
products.description: Clinical care team assignments for patients, documenting which providers are responsible for a patient's care in a given context. products.name: advance_directive
products.description: Patient advance directive and end-of-life care preference documentation including DNR (Do Not Resuscitate) orders, POLST/MOLST (Physician/Medical Orders for Life-Sustaining Treatment), living wills, healthcare power of attorney designations, and code status (Full Code, DNR, DNR/DNI, Comfort Care). domains.name: order
domains.description: Manages the full lifecycle of clinical orders including CPOE (Computerized Physician Order Entry) for lab, radiology, pharmacy, and referral orders. Tracks order status, priority, routing, and fulfillment. Integrates with Epic Orders, Beaker (LIS), Radiant (RIS), and Willow (pharmacy) as the operational order management backbone.

products.name: clinical_order
products.description: Core master record for every clinical order entered via CPOE (Computerized Physician Order Entry) in Epic Orders or Cerner Millennium. Captures the authoritative order identity, ordering provider NPI, patient MRN, order type (lab, radiology, pharmacy, referral, nursing, dietary, consult), order priority (STAT, routine, urgent, timed), order mode (verbal, written, electronic), clinical indication (ICD-10 coded), ordering datetime, start and stop datetimes, order source system, order set membership flag, parent order reference for linked/chained orders, current order status, and order class (inpatient, outpatient, ED, ambulatory). SSOT for all clinical order identity, metadata, and type/priority classification across the enterprise. Absorbs order_type and order_priority reference attributes as embedded enums. All modality-specific attributes are owned by extension products (lab_order, radiology_order, pharmacy_order, referral_order).

attributes.references: Epic Orders; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.authoredOn; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: order_entered_datetime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the order was physically entered into the EHR system, which may differ from order_datetime (the clinically intended order time) for verbal or backdated orders. Used for CPOE compliance auditing and order authentication tracking.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; TJC NPSG.02.03.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24

attributes.name: order_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the clinical order was entered or communicated. Electronic orders are entered directly via CPOE; verbal and telephone orders require co-signature per regulatory requirements. Supports compliance auditing and order authentication tracking.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; TJC NPSG.02.03.01 (Verbal Orders); CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24

attributes.name: order_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the ordered item or service as displayed in the EHR (e.g., 'CBC with Differential', 'Chest X-Ray PA and Lateral', 'Metoprolol 25mg PO'). Sourced from the Charge Description Master (CDM) or order catalog.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; CDM (Charge Description Master); LOINC; SNOMED CT

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable order identifier assigned by the source system (Epic Orders or Cerner Millennium). Used for cross-system reconciliation, audit trails, and communication with clinical staff. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.identifier

attributes.name: order_priority
attributes.description: Clinical urgency classification for the order. STAT indicates immediate action required; timed indicates a specific scheduled execution time. Embedded enum per product design specification. Drives turnaround time (TAT) SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.priority; TJC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the clinical order. Drives downstream fulfillment routing and reporting. Values align with Epic Orders and HL7 FHIR ServiceRequest status codes.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.status; The Joint Commission (TJC) Order Management Standards

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the clinical order by modality or service category. Determines routing to the appropriate fulfillment system: Beaker (LIS) for lab, Radiant (RIS) for radiology, Willow for pharmacy, etc. Embedded enum per product design specification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lab|radiology|pharmacy|referral|nursing|dietary|consult — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.category; LOINC; CPT (AMA)

attributes.name: ordering_provider_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the clinician who placed the order. Stored denormalized on the order for regulatory reporting, claims submission, and audit purposes per CMS requirements. Distinct from the FK to the provider master.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.408; CMS-1500; UB-04

attributes.name: patient_mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number (MRN) of the patient for whom the order was placed. Stored denormalized on the order for cross-system reconciliation, HL7 ADT message processing, and regulatory audit trails. Sourced from the Master Patient Index (MPI).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4; Epic MPI; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the ordered item or service (e.g., number of lab panels, number of imaging views, medication dose quantity). Unit of measure is captured in quantity_unit. Used for supply chain, pharmacy dispensing, and charge capture.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.quantity

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity_ordered field (e.g., 'mg', 'mL', 'units', 'each', 'tablet'). Follows UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure) standards for interoperability with HL7 FHIR.
attributes.references: UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure); HL7 FHIR R4; Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium

attributes.name: start_datetime
attributes.description: Datetime when the order is scheduled to begin or when fulfillment should commence. For timed orders, this is the precise execution start time. Distinct from order_datetime (when placed) and order_datetime (when entered).
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.occurrencePeriod.start

attributes.name: stop_datetime
attributes.description: Datetime when the order expires, is discontinued, or fulfillment should cease. Critical for pharmacy and nursing orders to prevent over-administration. Nullable for one-time orders.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.occurrencePeriod.end

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this clinical order record was last modified in the enterprise data lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

products.name: order_status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of every lifecycle event for a clinical order, including status transitions, modifications (dose, frequency, route, priority changes), amendments, corrections, renewals, and discontinuations. Captures event type, previous and new values, modification details, the datetime of each event, the user or system that triggered it, reason codes, clinical justification, co-signature requirements for modifications, modifying provider NPI, and the source system event. SSOT for all order lifecycle changes — no other product in this domain records order state transitions or modifications. Supports HIPAA audit compliance, CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement), medication reconciliation, and clinical quality review.
products.reference: Epic Orders Status Audit / HL7 ORC Segment

attributes.name: order_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order lifecycle event record in the immutable audit trail. Primary key for this append-only event log.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) — Audit Controls

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical order whose lifecycle event is being recorded. Links this history record to the originating order in the order management system (Epic Orders / Cerner Millennium).
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium PowerChart

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Clinical Decision Support (CDS) alert (drug-drug interaction, allergy, dosing alert, duplicate order) that was triggered and may have prompted this lifecycle event. Null if no CDS alert was associated. Supports CDS effectiveness analysis and alert fatigue reporting.
attributes.references: ONC 21st Century Cures Act; Epic CDS; AHRQ Patient Safety

attributes.name: primary_order_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician who originally placed the order. Used for accountability tracking and CPOE audit trails.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; CPOE Standards

attributes.name: scheduling_appointment_id
attributes.description: The HL7 message control ID (MSH-10) of the HL7 v2 or FHIR message that triggered or communicated this order lifecycle event. Supports interoperability audit trails and Health Information Exchange (HIE) reconciliation.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x MSH-10; HL7 FHIR R4 MessageHeader.id; HIE Standards

attributes.name: set_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical order set or protocol from which the parent order was generated, if applicable. Supports analysis of order set adherence and protocol-driven order modification patterns.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium; AHRQ Clinical Decision Support

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter (visit, admission, or ED episode) during which this order lifecycle event occurred. Supports encounter-level order audit and CDI review.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter Resource; Epic Orders

attributes.name: cds_alert_overridden
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Alert Overridden Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Clinical Decision Support (CDS) alert was overridden by the provider when this event was triggered. True = alert was acknowledged and overridden; False = alert was not overridden or no alert was present. Critical for patient safety audit and alert override rate reporting.
attributes.references: ONC 21st Century Cures Act; AHRQ Patient Safety; Joint Commission NPSG

tag_set.value: Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Alert Overridden Flag

attributes.name: cosignature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order modification or event requires a co-signature from a supervising or authorizing provider before the change takes effect. Applies to resident/trainee orders and controlled substance modifications per institutional policy.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24; DEA 21 CFR Part 1306

attributes.name: cosignature_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the required co-signature was completed by the supervising provider. Null if co-signature has not yet been obtained. Used to measure co-signature turnaround time for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this history record was first written to the lakehouse silver layer. Represents the ETL ingestion time, distinct from event_timestamp (the real-world clinical event time). Used for data pipeline monitoring and late-arrival detection.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; HITRUST CSF; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule (CI through CV) applicable to the medication order at the time of this event. Populated only when is_controlled_substance is True. Determines regulatory handling requirements.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: discontinuation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the reason category for order discontinuation when event_type is DISCONTINUATION. AMA = Against Medical Advice. Supports medication reconciliation, discharge planning, and quality reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: COMPLETED|PROVIDER_DISCONTINUED|PATIENT_REFUSED|AMA|FORMULARY|DUPLICATE|PROTOCOL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.statusReason; Joint Commission MM.04.01.01; AMA Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time at which this lifecycle event becomes clinically effective (e.g., when a renewed order becomes active, when a hold is lifted). May differ from event_timestamp when events are scheduled or backdated. Supports medication administration record (MAR) reconciliation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.occurrenceDateTime; Epic Orders; MAR Standards

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for all lifecycle events belonging to the same parent order. Enables chronological ordering of events within an order's history and detection of out-of-order event delivery from source systems.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent; Epic Orders Audit Log; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which this lifecycle event occurred in the clinical system. This is the authoritative real-world event time, distinct from record audit timestamps. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent.recorded

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the kind of lifecycle event recorded. STATUS_CHANGE = workflow state transition; MODIFICATION = dose/frequency/route/priority change; AMENDMENT = clinical content update; CORRECTION = error correction; RENEWAL = order re-authorization; DISCONTINUATION = order stopped; COSIGN_REQUEST = co-signature required; COSIGN_COMPLETED = co-signature fulfilled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STATUS_CHANGE|MODIFICATION|AMENDMENT|CORRECTION|RENEWAL|DISCONTINUATION|COSIGN_REQUEST|COSIGN_COMPLETED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Task.status; Epic Orders Event Types; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: hipaa_audit_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Audit Category
attributes.description: HIPAA-defined audit event category for this order lifecycle event, used for compliance reporting to OCR and internal privacy audits. Classifies the event as an access, modification, disclosure, correction, or deletion of PHI per HIPAA Security Rule requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); OCR Audit Protocol; HITRUST CSF Control 09.aa

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Audit Category

attributes.name: is_amendment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event represents a formal clinical amendment to the order record (as opposed to a routine status change or system-generated update). True = formal amendment requiring clinical documentation. Supports HIM and CDI amendment tracking.
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.01.03.01; HIM Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.526

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order subject to this lifecycle event involves a DEA-scheduled controlled substance. True = controlled substance order. Triggers enhanced audit requirements and DEA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1306; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); State Pharmacy Boards

attributes.name: is_verbal_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order event was initiated as a verbal or telephone order requiring subsequent written authentication. True = verbal/telephone order; False = directly entered CPOE order. Tracked for Joint Commission verbal order compliance.
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24(c)(1)(ii)

attributes.name: modified_field_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific clinical order field that was changed during a MODIFICATION, AMENDMENT, or CORRECTION event (e.g., 'dose', 'frequency', 'route', 'quantity', 'priority', 'start_date', 'stop_date', 'indication'). Null for pure status transitions.
attributes.references: Epic Orders Audit Log; Cerner Millennium Audit Trail; CDI Standards

attributes.name: modifying_provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the licensed provider who triggered this event, when the modifying user is a credentialed clinician. Denormalized from the provider record to preserve the NPI value at the time of the event for regulatory audit purposes. Required for CMS and OIG compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); OIG

attributes.name: modifying_user_role
attributes.description: The clinical or operational role of the user who triggered this lifecycle event at the time of the event. Supports role-based audit analysis and compliance review (e.g., identifying unauthorized order modifications). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PHYSICIAN|NURSE|PHARMACIST|RESIDENT|SYSTEM|ADMIN|TECHNICIAN — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(a)(1); Joint Commission; OIG Compliance

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The order workflow status immediately after this lifecycle event. Together with previous_status, defines the state transition that occurred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|PENDING|ACTIVE|HOLD|SUSPENDED|COMPLETED|DISCONTINUED|CANCELLED|EXPIRED|ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.status; Epic Orders Status Codes

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The value of the modified clinical field immediately after this modification event. Paired with previous_value to form a complete before/after audit record. Contains PHI when the field relates to medication or clinical details.
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); CDI Standards

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: The human-readable, externally visible order identifier (e.g., Epic order number, Cerner accession number) at the time of this event. Denormalized from the order header to support direct lookup in audit reports without joining to the order table.
attributes.references: Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium; Joint Commission RC.01.02.01

attributes.name: order_priority
attributes.description: The priority level of the order at the time of this event. Captures the priority as it existed at this point in the lifecycle, enabling detection of priority escalations or de-escalations over time.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.priority; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the clinical order category at the time of this event. Determines routing to downstream fulfillment systems: LAB → Beaker/LIS; RADIOLOGY → Radiant/RIS; PHARMACY → Willow; REFERRAL → Cadence. Denormalized here to support event-level analytics without joining back to the order header. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LAB|RADIOLOGY|PHARMACY|REFERRAL|PROCEDURE|NURSING|DIET|CONSULT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.category; Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: The structured or free-text reason provided by the provider when overriding a Clinical Decision Support (CDS) alert associated with this order event. Populated only when cds_alert_overridden is True. Supports patient safety review and quality improvement programs.
attributes.references: ONC 21st Century Cures Act; AHRQ Patient Safety; Joint Commission NPSG.03.06.01

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The order workflow status immediately before this lifecycle event. Enables reconstruction of the full state machine history and supports CDI review and medication reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|PENDING|ACTIVE|HOLD|SUSPENDED|COMPLETED|DISCONTINUED|CANCELLED|EXPIRED|ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.status; Epic Orders Status Codes

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: The value of the modified clinical field (dose, frequency, route, priority, quantity, etc.) immediately before this modification event. Stored as a string to accommodate heterogeneous field types across order categories. Populated only for MODIFICATION, AMENDMENT, and CORRECTION event types. Contains PHI when the field relates to medication or clinical details.
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); CDI Standards

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Structured reason code explaining why this lifecycle event occurred (e.g., CLINICAL_CHANGE, PATIENT_REQUEST, PROVIDER_CORRECTION, DUPLICATE_ORDER, ALLERGY_ALERT, DRUG_INTERACTION, FORMULARY_SUBSTITUTION, PROTOCOL_CHANGE). Sourced from the EHR reason code catalog. Supports CDI and quality review workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 ServiceRequest.reasonCode; Epic Orders; Joint Commission

attributes.name: reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text clinical justification or narrative explanation provided by the user or system for this lifecycle event. Supplements the structured reason_code with provider-authored context. May contain PHI when clinical rationale references patient-specific information.
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); CDI Standards

attributes.name: renewal_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter indicating which renewal iteration this event represents for the parent order. Starts at 1 for the first renewal. Null for non-renewal events. Supports chronic medication management and long-term order tracking.
attributes.references: Epic Willow; Cerner PharmNet; Joint Commission MM.04.01.01

attributes.name: transmission_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time at which this order event was transmitted to the downstream fulfillment system (Beaker, Radiant, Willow, etc.). Null if transmission is not required or has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Task.lastModified; Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium

attributes.name: transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the order transmission to the downstream fulfillment system (pharmacy, lab, radiology) following this lifecycle event. Tracks whether the event was successfully communicated to the executing department.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Task.status; Epic Orders; Cerner Millennium

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this history record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Although the event log is intended to be immutable, this field captures any correction or reprocessing events applied to the record for data quality purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; HITRUST CSF; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: verbal_order_authentication_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time at which a verbal or telephone order was authenticated (signed) by the ordering provider. Null for non-verbal orders. Must occur within the timeframe required by Joint Commission standards (typically 24-48 hours).
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24(c)(1)(ii)

attributes.name: workstation_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical workstation, device, or terminal from which this order lifecycle event was initiated. Supports HIPAA access audit trails and security incident investigation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

products.name: fulfillment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the completion or execution of a clinical order by the fulfilling department, serving as the order domain's acknowledgment that downstream work was performed. Captures fulfillment datetime, fulfilling provider or technician, fulfillment location, fulfillment method, actual vs. ordered quantity, partial fulfillment indicator, fulfillment notes, exception reason if the order was not fulfilled as ordered, fulfillment status, and turnaround time (order-to-fulfillment elapsed time). Bridges the order intent (clinical_order) with the result or dispensing event in downstream domains (laboratory, radiology, pharmacy). SSOT boundary: this product tracks fulfillment status and timing from the order perspective only. Detailed result data (lab values, imaging reports, dispensing records) is owned by the respective downstream domain — laboratory, radiology, or pharmacy.

products.name: rx_claim

products.description: Transactional record of every individual laboratory test result produced for a specimen, including result amendments and critical value notifications. Stores LOINC-coded test identifier, result value (numeric, text, coded), result unit of measure, reference range applied, result status lifecycle (preliminary, final, corrected, cancelled), abnormal flag (normal, low, high, critical low, critical high), result date/time, performing lab section, instrument identifier, verifying technologist. Owns the full amendment/correction history: original value, amended value, amendment reason, amending user, amendment timestamp. When a result exceeds critical thresholds, owns the critical value alert lifecycle: alert generation timestamp, notified provider, notification method (phone, secure message, EHR alert), acknowledgment timestamp, acknowledging clinician, escalation actions, and resolution notes. Consolidates the former critical_value_alert and result_amendment concepts. Supports CLIA critical value compliance, Joint Commission NPSG requirements, HIM audit requirements, and downstream clinical decision-making.

products.name: transfusion_event
products.description: Transactional record of the full blood product transfusion lifecycle from crossmatch/compatibility testing through administration and post-transfusion monitoring. Owns crossmatch and compatibility testing: crossmatch type (electronic, immediate spin, full serologic), compatibility result (compatible, incompatible), antibody screen result, unexpected antibody identification, patient blood sample reference, performing technologist, crossmatch date/time. Owns transfusion administration: blood bank unit transfused, transfusion start and end date/time, transfusion site, administering nurse, pre- and post-transfusion vital signs, transfusion reaction indicator and type, reaction severity, and clinical indication. Consolidates the former crossmatch product. Supports hemovigilance reporting, AABB compliance, blood bank audit trails, and patient safety surveillance.

attributes.name: software_version

attributes.name: tesla_field_strength

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Facility-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this imaging equipment unit within the enterprise. Used as the operational business identifier in RIS scheduling, order routing, and PACS integration (e.g., CT01, MRI-3T-02). Corresponds to the equipment code in Epic Radiant and Cerner RadNet.

attributes.name: unit_name

attributes.references: Epic Radiant Equipment Master; Cerner RadNet; ACR Practice Parameter

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312(b); ISO 27001 A.12.4; HITRUST CSF Control 09.aa

products.name: protocol
products.description: Defines standardized acquisition protocols for each modality and clinical indication combination. Stores protocol name, modality type, clinical indication, body part, contrast requirement flag, contrast agent type, slice thickness, kVp, mAs, field of view, reconstruction algorithm, scan duration estimate, patient preparation instructions, protocol version, effective date, and approving radiologist. Enables consistent image quality and supports radiation dose optimization programs. Managed within Epic Radiant protocol library.
